jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Trust & Platform Security
jobs.description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

We are hiring a Senior Software Engineer for our Trust Center team. This team is building the next generation of Data Exfiltration Protection (DXP) and unified Data Movement Policies (DMP) for Snowflake's cloud security infrastructure. You will work at the intersection of security policy and system enforcement, helping ensure that perimeter controls are robust, scalable, and deeply integrated with context-aware access frameworks.




AS A SENIOR SOFTWARE ENGINEER, TRUST & PLATFORM SECURITY AT SNOWFLAKE, YOU WILL:

 - Design and implement core components of the Data Movement Policy (DMP) framework, supporting complex multi-cloud and hybrid environments

 - Build and enhance Data Exfiltration Protection capabilities, including ingress and egress controls and anomaly detection for data movement

 - Contribute to the effort to unify Context-Aware Access policies with egress perimeter controls into a cohesive policy engine

 - Author and review design documents for DMP and Perimeter Policy features, with a focus on reliability, low latency, and auditability

 - Partner with Product Management and peer engineers to translate product requirements into well-scoped engineering deliverables

 - Mentor junior engineers on the team and drive high standards for code quality, testing, and security-first development practices

 - Own end-to-end delivery of features from design through production deployment




OUR IDEAL SENIOR SOFTWARE ENGINEER, TRUST & PLATFORM SECURITY WILL HAVE:

 - 5+ years of experience in software engineering, with meaningful exposure to infrastructure or security systems

 - Strong understanding of network security fundamentals (TLS/SSL, HTTP/S, DNS), Zero Trust principles, or Data Loss Prevention (DLP) concepts

 - Proven ability to design and build distributed systems in Java, Go, or C++

 - Experience working with cloud-native security controls in AWS, GCP, or Azure (e.g., VPC Service Controls, Private Link), or equivalent experience

 - Comfort working independently on complex technical problems while collaborating closely with cross-functional partners

 - BS/MS in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience




BONUS POINTS FOR THE FOLLOWING:

 - Experience with content-aware or identity-driven data governance systems

 - Familiarity with AI-assisted development workflows and tooling

 - Prior work on egress control, network perimeter enforcement, or policy engine design

 - Contributions to open-source security projects or published security research

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com http://careers.snowflake.com

jobs.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer, Platform
jobs.description:
ABOUT SENTRY

Software runs the world and the pace is faster than ever. Sentry helps developers fix errors and performance issues before users notice, so teams can spend less time firefighting and more time building.

Trusted by 200,000+ organizations, Sentry is today’s application monitoring standard and our team is building its AI-native future.




ABOUT THE ROLE

A strong and reliable platform is essential to scaling Sentry for the future. Our Platform organization is responsible for everything that powers Sentry—from cloud infrastructure and streaming systems to storage, deployment, and security. We own the core services and technical foundations that enable every product and engineering team at Sentry to move fast and build with confidence.



We're looking for a passionate and pragmatic Senior Staff Software Engineer to help lead this evolution. In this role, you’ll report directly to the VP of Engineering and collaborate with teams across the company to shape the future of Sentry’s platform.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Architect the future of Sentry by translating business needs and product strategy into clear, scalable technical blueprints.

 - Partner with product and engineering leaders to align technical roadmaps with company goals.

 - Lead cross-cutting initiatives across the Platform org—owning them end-to-end and driving meaningful outcomes.

 - Promote engineering excellence by mentoring platform engineers, sharing best practices, and setting high standards for system design, scalability, and operational quality.

 - Review major architectural proposals and help ensure consistency, maintainability, and long-term technical health across the company.




YOU’LL LOVE THIS JOB IF YOU...

 - Enjoy designing and building platforms that help teams move faster and scale safely.

 - Thrive on solving complex, multi-dimensional problems across product, infrastructure, and organizational layers.

 - Want to make architectural decisions that shape Sentry’s long-term success.

 - Bring new ideas, tools, and frameworks to the table—and know when to optimize for simplicity over novelty.

 - Enjoy working closely with senior leadership and cross-functional partners to drive company-wide initiatives.




QUALIFICATIONS

 - 12+ years of experience building large-scale distributed systems.

 - 5+ years working in cloud-based environments (AWS, GCP, etc.).

 - 3+ years in a technical architecture or equivalent leadership role.

 - Proven track record of leading cross-team, high-impact engineering projects.

 - Ability to create production-quality proof-of-concept architectures and write high-quality code.

 - Deep knowledge of modern infrastructure technologies, including:
   
   - Kubernetes, Terraform, Service Mesh
   
   - Kafka and real-time streaming frameworks (e.g., Flink, Beam)
   
   - OLAP/OLTP databases, blob storage, caching

 - Excellent communication skills, with the ability to clearly explain complex technical concepts to a range of stakeholders.

 - Experience mentoring senior/staff-level engineers.



The base salary range that Sentry reasonably expects to pay for this position is $260,000 to $400,000 plus up to 20% bonus. A successful candidate’s actual base salary (or hourly wage) amount will be determined by a variety of relevant factors including, without limitation, the candidate’s work location, education, work and other relevant experience, skills, and job-related knowledge. A successful candidate will be eligible to participate in Sentry’s employee benefit plans/programs applicable to the candidate’s position (including incentive compensation, equity grants, paid time off, and group health insurance coverage). See Sentry Benefits https://sentry.io/careers/ for more details about the Company’s benefit plans/programs.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY AT SENTRY

Sentry is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to its employees and candidates for employment regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, veteran status, or other legally-protected characteristic. This commitment includes the provision of reasonable accommodations to employees and candidates for employment with physical or mental disabilities who require such accommodations in order to (a) perform the essential functions of their jobs, or (b) seek employment with Sentry. We strive to build a diverse team, with an inclusive culture where every teammate can thrive. Sentry is an open-source company because we believe that everyone, everywhere, should have the ability and tools to make great software. Software should be accessible. That starts with making our industry accessible.

If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, you may contact us at accommodations@sentry.io.

Want to learn more about how Sentry handles applicant data? Get the details in our Applicant Privacy Policy https://sentry.io/careers/applicantprivacy/.

jobs.title: Tech Lead, Ramp Travel
jobs.description:
ABOUT RAMP

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.




ABOUT THE ROLE

The Ramp Travel team builds the travel booking and management platform built-in to Ramp. We build the capabilities that allows travelers to stay productive on the road: flight and hotel search, booking and checkout, our agentic travel assistant, and on-the-go mobile trip guidance. We also own the capabilities that ensure companies are spending their travel dollars effectively: travel policy evaluation, supplier and TMC integrations and benchmarking, and data insights.

Growing the sophistication and global reach of the Travel product is a top strategic priority at Ramp. The work this team does directly enables Ramp to to support some of the largest and most interesting customers in the world.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Lead, mentor, coach, and grow the Ramp Travel engineering team (~6 engineers today).

 - Own delivery across our travel management surfaces: search and inventory, quoting and repricing, checkout, policy evaluation, loyalty, post-booking servicing.

 - Own reliability and correctness of a system dependent on third parties: supplier APIs, GDS and aggregator content, TMC and OBT integrations.

 - Partner with Product, Design, Ops, Partnerships, and Sales on enterprise travel commitments.

 - Set the team's practices for AI-assisted development and ship agentic booking features.

 - Hire. The team is expected to grow.


WHAT YOU'LL NEED

 - 2+ years managing engineers, team size roughly 5 to 15.

 - High levels of ownership. Comfortability taking difficult ambiguous problems and driving successful execution.

 - Has built something 0→1 and then scaled it.

 - Willing to be hands-on. This is a six-person team, and everyone at Ramp is a builder.

 - Current enough technically to lead a design review and evaluate an architecture proposal.

 - Strong product judgment and comfort talking to customers.

 - Has owned a transactional system with external dependencies: booking, payments, marketplace, or logistics.


PREFERRED

 - Corporate travel domain experience, such as: corporate online booking tools (OBTs), integrations with travel content sources (GDS/NDC), and front-end traveler experiences.

 - Enterprise B2B fintech or T&E background.

 - Has rolled out agentic dev tooling to a team, or shipped LLM-backed features.




BENEFITS AVAILABLE TO ALL FULL-TIME RAMP EMPLOYEES (GLOBAL)

 - Flexible PTO

 - Centralized home-office equipment ordering

 - Health and wellness stipend

 - Budget for intra-office travel

 - Weekly coffee stipend




UNITED STATES

 - 100% medical, dental & vision insurance coverage for you, with partial coverage for dependents

 - One Medical annual membership

 - 401(k), including employer match on contributions made while employed by Ramp

 - Fertility HRA (up to $10,000 per year)

 - Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay

 - Pet insurance

 - In-office perks: lunch, snacks, drinks, and more

 - Relocation expense coverage to NYC or SF (if needed)
   
   


CANADA

 - Group medical, dental, and vision coverage through Sun Life

 - Life, AD&D, and disability coverage

 - Fertility drug coverage (up to $4,000 lifetime)

 - Group Retirement Plan with employer match (RRSP + DPSP)

 - Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay, with additional time available at reduced pay

 - Employee Assistance Program and virtual care through Lumino Health




UNITED KINGDOM

 - Private medical insurance through Freedom Elite

 - Virtual GP and at-home care via eMed x Livi

 - Workplace pension through Penfold, with salary sacrifice option

 - Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay with additional time available at reduced pay




REFERRAL INSTRUCTIONS

If you are being referred for the role, please contact that person to apply on your behalf.

 


OTHER NOTICES

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

 

Beware of recruiting scams: Ramp will only contact you through official @Ramp.com http://Ramp.com email addresses and will never ask for payment or sensitive personal information during the hiring process.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Ecosystem
jobs.description:
ABOUT AIRWALLEX

Airwallex is the only unified payments and financial platform for global businesses. Powered by our unique combination of proprietary infrastructure and software, we empower over 250,000 businesses worldwide – including Brex, Navan, Qantas, SHEIN and many more – with fully integrated solutions to manage everything from business accounts, payments, spend management and treasury, to embedded finance at a global scale.

Proudly founded in Melbourne, we have a team of over 2,300 of the brightest and most innovative people in tech across 27 offices around the globe. Valued at US$11 billion and backed by world-leading investors including T. Rowe Price, Visa, Mastercard, Robinhood Ventures, Sequoia, Salesforce Ventures, DST Global, and Lone Pine Capital, Airwallex is leading the charge in building the global payments and financial platform of the future. If you’re ready to do the most ambitious work of your career, join us.

 


ATTRIBUTES WE VALUE

We hire successful builders with founder-like energy who want real impact, accelerated learning, and true ownership. You bring strong role-related expertise and sharp thinking, and you’re motivated by our mission and operating principles https://www.airwallex.com/us/operating-principles. You move fast with good judgment, dig deep with curiosity, and make decisions from first principles, balancing speed and rigor.

You're humble and collaborative; turn zero‑to‑one ideas into real products, and you “get stuff done” end-to-end. You use AI to work smarter and solve problems faster. Here, you’ll tackle complex, high‑visibility problems with exceptional teammates and grow your career as we build the future of global banking. If that sounds like you, let’s build what’s next.

 


ABOUT THE TEAM

Join our Ecosystem team, a cross-functional group of engineers and product partners building the platforms and integrations that connect Airwallex with the software our customers rely on every day. We own strategic accounting, marketplace, payment plugins, and open‑banking integrations, as well as the infrastructure that powers our public APIs that enabling third-party partners to build on top of. You’ll work closely with backend, product, design, and go‑to‑market teams to ship secure, reliable experiences that simplify financial operations for businesses of all sizes and unlock new use cases on top of the Airwallex business account.

 


WHAT YOU'LL DO

As a member of our team, you will have the opportunity to work on cutting-edge technologies and contribute to the growth and success of our company. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to design, develop, and maintain the ecosystem platform, build and integrate APIs to connect with external financial institutions and third-party platforms (accounting, HR, ERP, marketplace, etc.), and develop scalable solutions to support our ecosystem strategy. 

You will also have the chance to work closely with product managers and designers to deliver innovative features and functionalities, as well as contribute to the technical roadmap and provide input on new technologies and best practices.

This role is based in Singapore.

 


RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Platform Architecture & Strategy: Lead the high-level design and long-term technical roadmap for the App Marketplace or Extension Framework.

 - Extensibility Frameworks: Design and implement the core SDKs, webhooks, and UI-extension patterns that allow third-party developers to embed their functionality directly into the Airwallex platform.

 - Technical Excellence: Establish and enforce rigorous internal coding standards, observability patterns, and security protocols for the entire team.

 - Developer Experience (DX): Champion the needs of external developers by building world-class documentation infrastructure, sandboxes, and tooling.

 


WHO YOU ARE

We're looking for people who meet the minimum qualifications for this role. The preferred qualifications are great to have, but are not mandatory.

 


MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related field

 - 2+ years of experience in developing Internet applications, large financial systems, or e-commerce platforms

 - Proficient in coding or scripting languages (Java/Kotlin/C++/Python, etc.)

 - Deep familiarity with the standard library, idiomatic usage, and best practices of your primary programming languages.

 - Ecosystem Experience: Direct experience building or maintaining a public-facing developer platform, app marketplace, or extension framework.

 


PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS: 

 - Architectural Patterns: Deep expertise in Domain-Driven Design (DDD) to manage complex business logic and microservice boundaries.

 - Infrastructure: Hands-on experience with cloud-native tech stacks, including Docker, Kubernetes, and advanced observability tools.

 - Emerging Tech: Experience integrating AI/LLM models to automate integration workflows or enhance developer tooling.


APPLICANT SAFETY POLICY: FRAUD AND THIRD-PARTY RECRUITERS

jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer (B2B SaaS Startup)
jobs.description: Our Mission Join us in reshaping global trade in a fast-growing startup! We are traide AI – a VC-backed, B2B deep tech startup based in Berlin, using AI to solve one of the most overlooked yet critical challenges in international trade: customs compliance. Our software automates product classification, reduces regulatory errors, and helps customers save up to 83% of their time. Trusted by leading brands like Siemens Healthineers, Koro, and Jack Wolfskin , we've achieved 2 x growth over the past 12 months – and we're just getting started. Your tasks At traide AI, we believe customs specialists deserve smarter, faster workflows and the future of global trade depends on it. As a Senior Backend Engineer , you'll play a pivotal role in builing robust, AI-powered backend services and infrastructure that drives the value creation for our customers. Your main expertise lies in backend technology but you should not be afraid to contribute to other parts of the application. You'll join a tight-knit, VC-backed B2B startup - calm but ambitious - where your ideas shape both product and culture. Product Development Own the end-to-end delivery of new features and improvements in our web application across the whole stack: shaping everything from technical design to production release Write both client-side and server-side code within our well-established codebases Analyse and communicate trade-offs in technical designs in RFC style discussions, drive decisions for your projects Be the backend expert in rotating project teams, give feedback on the contribution of other team members within your area of expertise Cross-functional collaboration Work alongside designers to shape user flows, evaluate feasibility, and improve interfaces and user experience Partner with AI engineers to bring cutting-edge research and prototypes into production-ready features Contribute your perspective to product discussions, helping set direction with both technical and user impact in mind Code quality & technical excellence Set and uphold high standards for code quality, architecture, and best practices within the team Design and maintain robust automated tests to ensure reliability and quality at scale Develop and improve instructions, guardrails and feedback mechanisms for coding agents Select and configure tooling that improves developer experience and keeps our CI/CD pipeline efficient Proactively identify and solve technical challenges before they become blockers Knowledge sharing Share your expertise through code reviews, mentoring, and documentation — helping others level up and ensuring our knowledge grows as the team grows Who we’re looking for You're an experienced engineer who cares deeply about craft, but even more about impact. You love clear thinking over hype, and you're energized by the idea of turning AI research into products people actually use every day. 7+ years of hands-on software engineering experience , ideally building complex products in dynamic environments Bachelor's degree (or higher) in Computer Science or a related discipline Deep proficiency in TypeScript , including advanced type-level programming Familiarity with synchronous and asynchronous communication patterns , HTTP APIs ( REST and GraphQL ), event-driven architecture, and common design patterns. Solid database skills across both relational and non-relational databases such as Postgres and Redis or similar. Hands-on experience with cloud platforms such as Google Cloud , and the services that typically come with them. You embrace AI tools in your workflow and are driven to master emerging technologies You champion code quality and drive best practices across the team You thrive in fast-moving environments - seeking opportunities to learn, grow, and both give and receive feedback Strong English skills (C1 or better); German is a plus but not required Curiosity about adjacent fields like DevOps, Security, Frontend development, AI Engineering etc. Our Tech Stack: React & Chakra UI (Component library) GraphQL Node.js & Prisma (ORM) Python & FastAPI & SQLAlchemy Postgres for storage & Redis for caching & messages Terraform / Open Tofu orchestrating Google Cloud Platform Why us? Varied day-to-day : Every feature comes with unique technical challenges → no two days are the same Visible impact : You'll see the direct results of your work → for both our customers and traide AI Direct impact on product : Your technical decisions shape what we ship and how it performs Team culture : You'll be part of a team that communicates transparently, values humor, and supports each other with respect and sincerity Flexible working : We enjoy working together in our office at Senefelder Platz in Berlin Prenzlauer Berg/Mitte. Home office is also an option for two days per week Be part of our regular team events (boot trips, bowling etc.) Enjoy benefits like an Urban Sports Club membership Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

jobs.description:
CoreWeave is The Essential Cloud for AI™. Built for pioneers by pioneers, CoreWeave delivers a platform of technology, tools, and teams that enables innovators to build and scale AI with confidence. Trusted by leading AI labs, startups, and global enterprises, CoreWeave combines superior infrastructure performance with deep technical expertise to accelerate breakthroughs and turn compute into capability. Founded in 2017, CoreWeave became a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: CRWV) in March 2025. Learn more at www.coreweave.com.
 
We re proud to be a Living Wage accredited Employer.

 

What You ll Do:

CoreWeave’s Physical AI Engineering team builds and scales the core platform powering advanced engineering simulation and AI workflows. Our ambition is to become the super-intelligent AI test lab for the engineering industry, delivering the performant, reliable, and scalable foundation trusted by the world’s largest engineering companies.

About the role: 

The Staff Frontend Engineer will own and evolve the Physical AI platform’s product surface: the data-heavy, workflow-centric web experience where engineers design experiments, compare runs, interact with agents, and convert complex test data into decisions. Operating at Staff-level scope (with openness to exceptional Senior Frontend Engineers ready to step into staff-level impact), you will own the frontend end-to-end-including component architecture, design system evolution, performance optimization, and production operations. In this role, you will collaborate closely with Design, Product, and Backend Engineering to design intuitive UIs for complex workflows, shape Python-backed API contracts, and integrate agentic capabilities safely. Additionally, you will drive frontend developer experience improvements, maintain high testing standards, and mentor engineers across the wider organisation.

Who You Are:

  • 7+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a track record of building, maintaining, and architecting complex, data-heavy web applications at Senior or Staff scope.
  • Advanced proficiency in React, TypeScript, and web fundamentals, with deep experience structuring large-scale frontends across modules, state management, routing, and data-fetching patterns.
  • Proven background building visualization-centric UIs, dashboards, charts, time-series metrics, or experiment explorers for complex datasets.
  • Hands-on experience integrating frontends with REST or GraphQL APIs, with a strong understanding of service-oriented architecture, data modeling, and Python web frameworks (e.g., FastAPI, Flask, Django).
  • Practical experience with database data flows (e.g., PostgreSQL), cloud/container infrastructure (Docker, Kubernetes), and frontend observability tools (Sentry, Datadog, OpenTelemetry).
  • Strong habits around testing frameworks (unit, integration, end-to-end), CI/CD pipelines, and frontend build tooling (Storybook, design systems, local dev ergonomics).
  • Excellent communication, cross-functional collaboration, and mentoring skills in high-ambiguity environments.

Preferred:

  • Experience building B2B SaaS UIs for technical audiences (e.g., ML engineers, data scientists, physical test engineers) or exposure to ML/AI workflows, experiment tracking, and agentic interfaces.
  • Hands-on experience with GraphQL, typed API clients in React, or SSR/SSG performance-focused frameworks.

Wondering if you re a good fit? 

We believe in investing in our people, and value candidates who can bring their own diversified experiences to our teams-even if you aren t a 100% skill or experience match. Here are a few qualities we ve found compatible with our team. If some of this describes you, we d love to talk.

  • You love to craft intuitive, detail-oriented web experiences that make complex, data-heavy engineering workflows feel seamless and fast.
  • You re curious about pushing the boundaries of Physical AI, agentic interfaces, and real-time experiment tracking platforms.
  • You re an expert in architecting scalable React/TypeScript systems, driving frontend performance, and mentoring teams on engineering craft.

Why CoreWeave?

At CoreWeave, we work hard, have fun, and move fast! We re in an exciting stage of hyper-growth that you will not want to miss out on. We re not afraid of a little chaos, and we re constantly learning. Our team cares deeply about how we build our product and how we work together, which is represented through our core values:

jobs.description:
Teamwork makes the stream work.

 

Roku is changing how the world watches TV

Roku is the #1 TV streaming platform in the U.S., Canada, and Mexico, and we ve set our sights on powering every television in the world. Roku pioneered streaming to the TV. Our mission is to be the TV streaming platform that connects the entire TV ecosystem. We connect consumers to the content they love, enable content publishers to build and monetize large audiences, and provide advertisers unique capabilities to engage consumers.

From your first day at Roku, you ll make a valuable - and valued - contribution. We re a fast-growing public company where no one is a bystander. We offer you the opportunity to delight millions of TV streamers around the world while gaining meaningful experience across a variety of disciplines.

 

About The Team

The Roku Enterprise Engineering team is at the forefront of building a robust, integrated, and scalable platform that powers critical business processes across the organization. As a cornerstone of Roku s corporate strategy, this team is instrumental in automating workflows across all Business Systems, including Supply Chain, Finance, Sales Operations, and Human Resources. By challenging traditional approaches to workflow automation, the team leverages cutting-edge Engineering practices and API-driven design to streamline internal processes, boost efficiency, and deliver innovative solutions.

The team s expertise spans a wide range of technologies, including Java and Python-based MicroServices, AWS/GCP cloud backend systems, Big Data technologies like Hive and Spark, and modern Web applications. With a globally distributed presence across the US, India and Europe, the team thrives on collaboration, bringing together diverse perspectives to solve complex challenges. At the heart of their success is a shared commitment to technical excellence, creativity, a strong sense of ownership, and a collaborative spirit that drives impactful results for Roku s business operations.

 

About The Role

As a senior technical lead, you consider yourself a platform services developer and developing innovative solutions using modern software frameworks and paradigms. You are self-driven and problem solver, with a strong background in building large-scale software platform and applications. You are execution focused and would develop a reputation for repeatedly delivering projects on-time.

 

What you ll be doing

  • Design, develop and deploy scalable web applications and services, being part of everything from contributing to web technology and framework stack, to use case and data model design
  • Drive architecture discussions, take ownership and responsibility over new projects, and deliver high quality software with tight timeline
  • Partner with security and compliance teams to ensure the application meets compliance, security and audit requirements
  • Participate in the continual improvement of engineering tools, cloud-based technologies/services, and process
  • Define and participate in Agile development process, including scoping, technical design, estimation effort, coding, testing, debugging, code reviews, maintenance and support
  • Collaborate with cross-function teams and demonstrate great communication skills

 

We re excited if you have

  • 5+ years of experience in delivery multi-tier, highly scalable, distributed web application
  • Deep understanding in software architecture, object-oriented design principles, and data structures
  • Extensive experience in developing microservices using Java, Python
  • Good experience in Test driven development and automating test cases using Java/ Python
  • Experience in SQL / NoSQL (Oracle, Cassandra) database design
  • Demonstrated ability to be proactive, self-driven, and make practical trade-offs based on business needs, entrepreneurial spirit
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • BS or MS degree in Computer Science or equivalent
  • Experience in distributed computing frameworks like - Hive/Hadoop, Apache Spark
  • Experience in developing Finance or HR related applications
  • Experience with following cloud services: AWS Elastic Beanstalk, EC2, S3, CloudFront, RDS, DynamoDB, VPC, Elastic Cache, Lambda
  • Working experience with Terraform
  • Experience in creating workflows for Apache Airflow
#LI-GL1

What s Roku s approach to hybrid working?

Roku fosters an inclusive and collaborative environment where teams generally work in the office Monday through Thursday. Fridays are generally flexible for remote work, except for employees whose specific roles or assigned office location require five days a week attendance.

 

What are some of the benefits?

Roku is committed to offering a diverse range of benefits as part of our compensation package to support our employees and their families. Our comprehensive benefits include global access to mental health and financial wellness support and resources. • Location: Bristol, London, Edinburgh UK Hybrid.
  • Level: C2
  • Team: Engineering
  • Salary: £45,000 - £62,000

This role can be based in our London, Bristol or Edinburgh offices, and requires an existing right to work in the UK.

At this time, we are not able to offer visa sponsorship for this role. We are committed to building a diverse, global team and our sponsorship policy is evaluated on a role-by-role basis. We encourage you to keep an eye on our careers site to stay informed about future opportunities where we are able to offer visa sponsorship.

Kaluza Overview

Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today’s challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future.

Our platform orchestrates millions of real-time decisions across homes, devices, markets and grids. By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable, affordable and adaptive to everyday life.

With teams across Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.

What will I be doing?

You ll be joining the Kaluza Technology community. We’re a large team of both data-led and product focused Software and Production Engineers, pushing the boundaries of technology and working at an extraordinary scale. 

As a collective we strive for engineering greatness and by ensuring best practices across the board of the community.

Our tech stack is fluid, but broadly you can find yourself working with:

Typescript, Node JS, Terraform, Gitactions, Kubernetes, Docker, AWS, Kafka, GraphQL 

Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain backend services using modern technologies like TypeScript and Node.js.
  • Learn to work with event-driven systems and cloud platforms (especially AWS).
  • Collaborate with other engineers, product managers, and designers to develop customer-facing features.
  • Write clean, maintainable code and participate in code reviews to grow your technical skills.
  • Contribute to the ongoing development of services and systems, with support from your team.
  • Work with databases (SQL or NoSQL) to manage and retrieve data.
  • Take part in team discussions, stand-ups, and planning sessions to understand how we build at scale.
  • Ask questions, seek feedback, and share what you’re learning to support a positive team environment.

About You 

Ideally, you ll have/be:

  • Some hands-on experience writing backend code, ideally in TypeScript, or keen to learn it.
  • A basic understanding of cloud technologies or interest in learning about platforms like AWS.
  • Familiarity with databases and APIs, and a desire to build reliable software.
  • A collaborative and open mindset, you re excited to learn from others and contribute to a team.
  • A curiosity for how things work and a proactive attitude to improving your skills.
  • Passion for building technology that solves real problems for users.
  • Bonus: exposure to frontend development

Where you ll work

We offer flexible working, with an expectation of 3 days a week in the office. This gives us the best of both: real time together to collaborate and build relationships, with the flexibility to work in the way that suits you best the rest of the week.

Kaluza Values

Here at Kaluza we have five core values that guide us as a business:

Play to win, Solve the real problem, Build trust every day, Own the outcome, Go further together.

Our Perks

  • Pension Scheme
  • Discretionary Bonus Scheme
  • Private Medical Insurance + Virtual GP
  • Life Assurance
  • Access to Furthr - a Climate Action app
  • Free Mortgage Advice and Eye Tests
  • Perks at Work - access to thousands of retail discounts
  • 5% Flex Fund - to spend on the benefits you want most
  • 26 days holiday
  • Progressive Leave Policy - With no qualifying service periods, including 26 weeks full pay if you have a new addition to your family
  • Personal Learning Budget - Upskill, learn and grow!
  • Home Office Budget
  • And more!

We want the best people

We’re keen to meet people from all walks of life — our view is that the more inclusive we are, the better our work will be. We want to build teams which represent a variety of experiences, perspectives and skills, and we recognise talent on the basis of merit and potential.

We understand some people may not apply for jobs unless they tick every box. But if you re excited about joining us and think you have some of what we re looking for, even if you re not 100% sure, we d still love to hear from you.

Find out more about working in Kaluza on our careers page and LinkedIn. You can also find our Applicant Data Protection Policy here.

TA FUTURE CONTRIBUTION

En tant que Staff Software Engineer, tu seras le·la garant·e de l’excellence logicielle, de la robustesse de l écosystème et de l interopérabilité des plateformes.
Tu seras notamment en charge de :

    Tu standardises nos méthodes de software engineering pour l ensemble de la Data & AI Platform et t appuies sur les communautés d experts du digital Decathlon pour y diffuser les meilleures pratiques.
    Tu apportes un cadre logiciel rigoureux aux applications clés développées côté Factory, notamment ARC et le Data Contract Registry.
  • Outillage Platform & Integration Agentic :
    Tu développes les briques logicielles complexes et exigeantes (APIs, SDKs internes, microservices) pour outiller les squads Data, MLOps et GenAI. Tu conçois l architecture technique assurant l interconnexion fluide, sécurisée et performante pour l agentic platform.
  • Exposition des Données (Projet RACE):

Tu garantis la haute disponibilité, la sécurité et la scalabilité de ces APIs afin de fluidifier les usages opérationnels et applicatifs.
  • Exploration Temps Réel & Streaming :
    Fort·e de tes connaissances sur l écosystème Kafka / Streaming, tu explores et expérimentes de nouvelles architectures d Analytics Engineering en temps réel.
  • Gouvernance & FinOps : 
    Tu orientes les choix d architecture avec un réflexe FinOps fort, en optimisant continuellement les performances d exécution dbt / Databricks et les coûts d infrastructures associées. 
  • Qualité & Gestion de la Dette :
     Tu joues un rôle de sentinelle en identifiant de manière proactive la dette technique sur l ensemble de la Data Platform et en orchestrant son assainissement avec les équipes produit et ingénierie.

  • Cloud AWS et GCP

  • Esprit Produit & FinOps : Tu es orienté·e valeur métier, simplicité d usage pour les utilisateurs finaux et rentabilité des choix d architecture.

Solve Complex Operational Problems Build solutions for: Real-time reservation and availability synchronization Dynamic pricing intelligence Smart lock access and key management Automated guest communication across channels Operational forecasting Cleaning and maintenance automation Owner reporting and financial workflows AI-powered monitoring and alerts Move Fast and Own Delivery Own projects end-to-end—from understanding an operator’s problem to architecture, implementation, deployment, and ongoing improvement. jobs.title: Enterprise Account Executive
jobs.description: The Opportunity: Data privacy has become one of the most strategic challenges facing modern enterprises — sitting at the intersection of AI governance, data operations, and customer trust. As companies adopt AI at scale, they need new ways to automate privacy and manage risk without slowing innovation. DataGrail has launched the first agentic privacy platform, and we're entering a pivotal phase of growth as we scale toward the next stage of the business. As an Enterprise Account Executive , you'll own the full sales cycle for our largest, most complex accounts — partnering with privacy, legal, security, and data leaders at enterprise brands to replace legacy tooling and stand up modern, automated privacy programs. Bring the experience, pave the way, and the organization will follow and support you across every stage of the deal. You'll have cross-departmental support, world-class marketing, a category-defining product, and an exploding privacy market at your side. The privacy landscape evolves daily. The work you do here will directly shape how DataGrail wins the enterprise — and how a category that's increasingly central to how modern companies operate gets defined. This is an opportunity for a seller who thrives on complex, consultative, multi-stakeholder deals and wants to be measured by the impact they create, not the activity they generate. What You'll Do: Own the complete enterprise sales cycle — from pipeline generation and discovery through negotiation, close, and expansion — across a defined territory of strategic accounts. Run complex, multi-threaded deals involving privacy, legal, security, IT, and executive stakeholders, navigating procurement and security review with a consultative, value-led approach. Consistently meet and exceed an annual quota of $1M+ in new and expansion ARR. Build and execute rigorous territory and account plans that identify where DataGrail creates the most value — and prioritize accordingly. Develop and manage a healthy, well-qualified pipeline — partnering with SDRs and Marketing on targeted, account-based pipeline generation while owning meaningful self-sourced opportunity creation — and move multiple deals through the funnel simultaneously with strong stage discipline and forecast accuracy. Lead discovery that uncovers the real business and regulatory drivers behind a privacy initiative — and translate them into a compelling, quantified business case. Partner closely with Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, Product, and Marketing to win deals as a team and set customers up for long-term success. jobs.description:
From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.

About Us
Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data.

Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on.

Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions.

As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact.

During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.

 

About Us

Fivetran and dbt Labs is building data pipelines to power the modern data stack for thousands of companies.


We re looking for a senior software engineer to join our Orchestration team, which owns the control plane layer of the dbt platform — the scheduler, execution harness, and results processing.

You ll own the design and delivery of features end to end, working across high-throughput APIs and data models to make them faster, more reliable, and more capable. You ll write and review designs, raise the quality bar in code review, use the latest AI tools, and collaborate closely with product and QE to deliver work that scales.

This is a full-time, fully remote position.

Technologies You ll Use
Python, Rust, GraphQL, Postgres, Snowflake, Kafka, Kubernetes, Docker, AWS, GCP, Datadog

  • Develop, maintain, and test high-quality, maintainable code, and optimize critical paths for performance

  • Improve test coverage with comprehensive unit tests and refactor code to drive down tech debt
  • Troubleshoot and debug production issues, and follow up on incidents with post-mortems and mitigation plans
  • Break features into tasks, structure and execute your own project plans, and contribute to sprint and feature planning
  • Collaborate with product managers, QE, customer support, and peers to deliver the best product with high quality, performance, and scalability

  • Use AI tooling — IDE assistants like GitHub Copilot, coding agents like Claude Code, and conversational AI — to accelerate development and to author and review SDLC artifacts such as TDDs, PRDs, post-mortems, and test plans

  • Experience working with distributed systems and cloud computing concepts
  • Demonstrated ability to write well-structured, performant, and well-tested code

  • Experience with continuous integration tooling such as BuildKite, and familiarity with observability tools like Datadog or Grafana is a plus
  • Fluent in using AI code assistants and coding agents to generate and investigate code, and conversational AI (e.g. Claude, ChatGPT) to research, author, review, and synthesize SDLC artifacts


Bonus Skills

  • Experience building or working with metadata, catalog, lineage, or discovery/search systems
  • Experience with GraphQL APIs and high-throughput, multi-tenant data services
  • Familiarity with the analytics engineering workflow and the dbt ecosystem

jobs.description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

This role is available for candidates located in Australia or Singapore.

The Opportunity:

Grafana Cloud is our composable observability platform that integrates metrics, logs, traces, and profiles with Grafana. It allows our customers to leverage the best open source observability software – including Prometheus, Mimir, Loki, Tempo, and Pyroscope – without the overhead of installing, maintaining and scaling their own observability stack.

The Databases team owns the telemetry databases that are Mimir for metrics, Loki for logs, Tempo for traces, and Pyroscope for profiles. Our databases are OSS projects that we also offer as a Cloud service supporting Grafana Cloud, and as an on-premise solution. Senior Frontend Engineer

An overview of this role

As a Senior Frontend Engineer, you ll solve high-scope frontend problems and influence your team s technical and product direction. You ll ship moderately sized features with minimal guidance, improve quality and performance, mentor other engineers, and help establish standards for a high-scale web environment. You ll partner across product, design, backend, and frontend to make sound trade-offs, communicate clearly, and improve how the team delivers software.

This is an opportunity to shape product experiences and frontend architecture for a global platform while helping define how modern frontend teams use agentic artificial intelligence. You ll apply artificial intelligence-assisted engineering workflows thoughtfully and help create trustworthy user experiences that incorporate artificial intelligence responsibly in a remote-first, asynchronous organization.

What you’ll do

  • Design and ship moderately sized frontend features and improvements with minimal guidance, making pragmatic architectural choices.
  • Turn ambiguous customer and product needs into clear technical plans and intuitive, accessible experiences.
  • Advocate for product quality, security, accessibility, performance, maintainability, and operational readiness throughout the development lifecycle.
  • Establish and improve practices for frontend architecture, styling, component design, testing, observability, maintainable code, and thoughtful use of artificial intelligence and agentic tools in production engineering work.
  • Mentor Associate and Intermediate Engineers, share knowledge, remove technical blockers, and improve team delivery practices.
  • Diagnose and prevent frontend performance and reliability issues at scale using observability and production signals, and participate in incident response or on-call responsibilities under your team s ownership model.
  • Design or review independently buildable frontend surfaces and explicit contracts for data, events, authorization, feature flags, error handling, testing, and performance expectations.
  • Collaborate with product, design, backend, quality, security, and other teams to deliver cohesive customer outcomes.

What you’ll bring

  • Experience applying frontend architecture, browser behavior, testing, accessibility, performance, and maintainability practices in a complex product or platform environment.
  • Experience designing or evolving modular frontend boundaries, independently buildable surfaces, component systems, or migration-safe architectures.

About the team

We own core repository capabilities, from Git command-line operations to web-based code exploration. Our roadmap includes feature and platform development, improvements to existing capabilities, maintainability, accessibility, performance, and workflows for teams using AI-assisted development tools.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Backend (Consumer Authentication Platform)
jobs.description:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

The Consumer Authentication Platform team is looking for a passionate Senior Software Engineer to help build the secure, reliable, and seamless authentication experiences that connect millions of consumers with Affirm’s financial products.

Authentication is the front door to Affirm. Our systems power critical consumer journeys (including sign-up, sign-in, account recovery, checkout authentication, step-up challenges, session management, and connected merchant experiences) across thousands of merchants and multiple countries. We build foundational capabilities such as authentication factors, identity federation, session and authorization services, and risk-based authentication that protect consumers while minimizing unnecessary friction. We work closely with Product, Security, Fraud, Identity, Analytics, Compliance, Data Science, and a wide range of engineering teams to both leverage existing systems and build new systems. This role requires a high level of technical capability, strong cross-functional communication, and a creative mindset. Our work needs to be secure, reliable, correct, scalable, and extensible. Our job is to build an authentication platform that balances security, regulatory requirements, fraud prevention, customer experience, and business growth.

As a senior engineer, you will lead significant technical initiatives, influence the architecture and evolution of the platform, and help the team deliver secure authentication capabilities that can be reused across products, merchants, and geographies.

What You’ll Do

  • You will own the technical design and delivery of significant authentication platform capabilities, leading projects from early requirements and architecture through implementation, rollout, and ongoing operation.
  • You will build secure, highly available systems that support consumer sign-in, authentication factors, account recovery, step-up authentication, session management, authorization, and identity federation.
  • You will support your peers and stakeholders in the product development lifecycle by collaborating with product management, Security, Fraud, Compliance, design, and analytics; participating in ideation; articulating technical constraints; and partnering on decisions that properly consider risks and trade-offs.
  • You will translate security, regulatory, fraud, and customer-experience requirements into pragmatic technical designs that appropriately balance risk, friction, complexity, and delivery speed.
  • You will proactively identify project, process, technology, security, reliability, or business issues, advocate for them, and lead in solving them.
  • You will support the operations and availability of your team’s artifacts by creating and monitoring metrics, escalating when needed, and supporting “keep the lights on,” and on-call efforts.
  • You will foster a culture of quality, security, and ownership on your team by setting or improving code review and design standards and advocating for them beyond your team through your writing and tech talks.
  • You will help develop talent on your team by providing feedback and guidance, mentoring other engineers through design reviews and hands-on collaboration, and leading by example.
  • You will clearly communicate technical decisions, constraints, risks, and trade-offs to engineering and non-engineering audiences through design documents, reviews, and technical discussions. You will lead the investigation and resolution of complex production issues and identify systemic improvements that prevent recurrence.

What We Look For

  • You have 4+ years of experience designing, developing, and launching backend systems at scale using languages like Python, Kotlin, Java, or another comparable modern programming language.
  • You have a track record of developing highly available distributed systems using technologies like AWS, MySQL, and Kubernetes, as well as relational databases, event-driven architectures, and RPC or API frameworks.
  • You have experience defining a technical plan for the delivery of a significant feature or system component with an elegant, secure, simple, and extensible design. You write high-quality code that is easily understood and used by others.
  • You are proficient at making significant changes in a large codebase and have developed a suite of tools and practices that enable you and your team to do so safely, including testing strategies, migration plans, and controlled rollouts.
  • Your experience demonstrates that you take ownership of your growth, proactively seeking feedback from your team, manager, and stakeholders, while helping other engineers grow through mentorship and technical leadership.
  • You have strong verbal and written communication skills that support effective collaboration with our global engineering team and cross-functional partners.
  • This position requires either equivalent practical experience or a bachelor’s degree in a related field.
  • Familiarity with standards and protocols such as OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, WebAuthn/passkeys, FIDO2, JWTs, and public-key cryptography. Knowledge of security and assurance frameworks such as the NIST Digital Identity Guidelines or PCI DSS.
  • Experience designing session-management, token-issuance, account-recovery, or multi-factor authentication systems. Familiarity with risk-based or adaptive authentication and the interaction between identity, security, compliance, and fraud controls.

Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

jobs.title: Data Center Controls Engineer
jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the Role

Anthropic is seeking an experienced Datacenter Controls Engineer to join our Datacenter Infrastructure team. In this role, you will design, implement, and optimize control systems that support our global datacenter infrastructure, enabling the reliable operation of AI at scale.

You will work on cutting-edge control systems managing critical datacenter operations including liquid cooling systems (CDUs/CDMs), HVAC, electrical power monitoring systems, and building automation systems. This position requires both technical depth in industrial automation and the ability to collaborate across disciplines to deliver integrated solutions for high-density AI compute infrastructure.

Responsibilities

System Architecture & Integration

  • Design and implement multi-site controls architecture across Anthropic s global datacenter facilities

  • Define network topology, redundancy, and high-availability requirements for control nodes and servers

  • Develop and maintain standardized frameworks for BACnet, Modbus TCP/IP, OPC-UA, MQTT, and SNMP communication layers

  • Ensure integration between control systems and enterprise networks while maintaining security boundaries and compliance with cybersecurity frameworks for industrial control systems

Control System Design & Implementation

  • Define, design, develop, and implement control systems for datacenter mechanical, electrical, and building management systems with focus on AI compute environments

  • Develop SCADA/BMS applications using platforms including Ignition, Niagara/Tridium, or similar HMI/supervisory systems

  • Select and specify instrumentation including sensors, transmitters, actuators, and control valves for liquid cooling loops, power distribution, and environmental monitoring

Data Collection & Visualization

  • Architect and supervise deployment of centralized telemetry systems capable of storing high-resolution time-series data from power, thermal, and environmental sensors

  • Develop intuitive dashboards and visualization layers using Ignition SCADA, Grafana, or comparable frameworks for facilities, operations, and engineering teams

  • Leverage control systems to enable performance insights, fault detection, and predictive maintenance capabilities

Construction Integration & Documentation

  • Participate in new design and construction projects to ensure controls and BMS standards are embedded from design through commissioning

  • Define and review controls and instrumentation specifications in architectural and MEP packages

  • Create comprehensive technical documentation including P&IDs, control narratives, sequence of operations, and commissioning procedures

  • Validate installed systems during commissioning for proper network configuration, protocol compatibility, and data visibility

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor s degree in Engineering (Electrical, Controls, Mechanical, Computer) or equivalent practical experience

  • 7+ years of experience in control systems design and implementation for industrial automation, building automation, or datacenter systems

  • Deep familiarity with industrial communication protocols: BACnet, Modbus TCP/IP, OPC-UA, MQTT, SNMP, Ethernet-IP

  • Experience with instrumentation selection, control panel design, and control system integration

  • Working knowledge of network architecture including subnets, VLANs, firewall rules, and IP management

  • Strong documentation skills and ability to work effectively in cross-functional teams

Preferred Qualifications

  • 10+ years in datacenter, critical facilities, or mission-critical infrastructure environments

  • Experience with liquid cooling systems including CDUs, CDMs, and cooling tower control systems

  • Background in high-density rack integration environments and AI/ML compute infrastructure

  • Experience designing or deploying BMS/SCADA systems such as Ignition, Niagara/Tridium, Wonderware, or similar

  • Strong background in database integration (SQL Server, InfluxDB, PostgreSQL, TimescaleDB) and data logging architecture

  • Proficiency in Python or scripting for automation/configuration within SCADA/BMS frameworks

  • Experience deploying multi-site redundant controls servers with high-availability requirements

  • Professional Engineering (PE) license or vendor certifications (Schneider, Rockwell, Siemens)

  • Knowledge of relevant codes and standards: ASHRAE, NFPA, IEEE, ISA

  • Familiarity with Grafana, Node-RED, Ignition Perspective, or equivalent visualization tools

  • Experience bridging cloud orchestration systems with facility-level power controls and load management (e.g., DCIM, BMS, EPMS)

jobs.description:
PREFECT https://www.prefect.io/ BUILDS AND OPERATES RESILIENT, PYTHONIC ORCHESTRATION AND MCP PLATFORMS -- PREFECT OSS https://github.com/PrefectHQ/prefect, PREFECT CLOUD https://www.prefect.io/prefect/cloud, FASTMCP OSS, https://gofastmcp.com/getting-started/welcome AND HORIZON  https://www.prefect.io/horizon-- USED FOR MISSION-CRITICAL WORKLOADS. 






Our Vision: Prefect will define automation for the context era.

Our Mission: Curate an intelligent context layer that delivers the right information at the right time.


About Prefect

Prefect builds automation for an unpredictable world. The last decade of automation was about protecting workflows from unpredictability; in the agentic era, unpredictability is the point. Our mission is to give people confidence in automated work, whether that work is a mission-critical data pipeline or a fleet of AI agents.

In August 2026, Prefect and Dagster, competitors for eight years, joined forces to build the next generation of automation infrastructure. Today, our ecosystem includes Dagster, the data platform; Prefect, the agent platform; and FastMCP, the leading open-source developer framework for the MCP ecosystem. Together, our open-source and commercial products are trusted by Fortune 500 companies, data innovators, and high-growth technology companies around the world.

We think of our culture as the operating system of the company. We’ve carefully created a supportive, high-performance environment that empowers our team to do the best work of their careers, have meaningful impact, and continue growing personally and professionally. We’re a remote-first team that values high standards, ownership, and thoughtful collaboration.


ROLE SUMMARY:

Prefect acquired Dagster this summer. Our sales engineers now sell three things. Prefect Cloud. Dagster+. And the next generation of AI tooling we're building across both: governed access to tools and data for agents, and durable workflows where agents and humans do the work together.

We're also selling something that isn't on a pricing page. FastMCP, our open-source MCP framework, sits inside a lot of production agent stacks, so teams come to us for how the whole thing should fit: the data layer, the orchestration layer, the context layer, and how agents and humans operate across all three. Much of what a sales engineer does here is demonstrate the art of the possible.

You're a Senior Sales Engineer on the Prefect subject-matter-expert pod, reporting to Wayne Grigsby, Sales Engineering Lead. The pod sits alongside our Dagster pod, and both roll up to George Coyne, Director of Sales Engineering, who runs the function end to end, pre-sale and post-sale.

This is a pre-sales seat. You pair with account executives on new business from the first technical call to signature: discovery, tailored demos, proofs of concepts, security and architecture reviews, and the slow procurement stretch at the end. You'll work across the whole platform. Your job is to figure out how the pieces fit for a given customer, then prove it.




WHAT YOU'LL DO:

 - Own the technical side of enterprise deals. From discovery through close: advising prospects, presenting and demonstrating the value of our platforms from a technical perspective.

 - Distill the use case. Most prospects don't arrive with a clean requirement. They arrive with a data platform, a pile of tools, a team of engineers and users expecting answers, and a budget. You figure out how our products fit together to solve for their use case, then help them validate the approach.

 - Sell across the platform. A single conversation can span Prefect, Dagster, FastMCP, hybrid architecture, and AI governance, often with a team that knows where it wants to end up but not how to get there.

 - Turn field signal into product direction. Sales engineers are the closest thing to a market pulse this company has. You'll carry what you hear into our GTM-engineering partnership channels, with evidence, and push when it matters.

 - Build the things we sell with. Demo environments, architecture diagrams, competitive battlecards, contributions to our internal repos, personal projects, and the occasional blog post.

 - Contribute and advocate for your ideas. Champion the culture, and keep projects from quietly failing. When something is going sideways, you say so early and you help fix it.




YOUR QUALIFICATIONS:

Five things. If you have these, apply, even if the nice-to-haves are thin.

 1. 3+ years of engineering experience, building real solutions. Data engineering, DevOps, software engineering, data science: the discipline matters less than the fact that you've built something programmatically and shipped it. Python is our house language.

 2. 2+ years in a customer facing role. Deep discovery skills and the habit of uncovering the real problem before proposing anything is key. You ask the second and third question, and you notice what the customer isn't saying.

 3. Curiosity first, then creativity. You take things apart to see how they work, and you don't stop at the docs. Then you put the pieces together in ways nobody handed you: a new use case, a demo that didn't exist yesterday, a workaround the customer didn't know was possible.

 4. You explain hard things clearly to engineers. What's required is that a senior platform engineer finishes a call with you and trusts you.

Nice to have:

 - 2+ years of prior sales engineering experience.

 - 2+ years of Enterprise infrastructure depth. In at least one major cloud (Azure, AWS, or GCP), and comfort with Kubernetes, networking, IAM, service mesh, and a production database like Postgres.

 - Orchestration tooling as a user, builder, or seller: Prefect, Dagster, Airflow, Temporal, Step Functions, etc.

 - Fascinated by AI and tinkering with MCP, agents, or LLM applications.




WHAT YOU'LL GET IN RETURN:

Base Salary Ranges :

 - San Francisco Bay Area & NYC Metro: $173,000–$222,000

 - Washington D.C., Boston, LA Metro, Seattl

jobs.description:

PRINCIPAL SOFTWARE ENGINEER - AGENTIC PIPELINES




BUILDING FOR AI-ENABLED DATA ENGINEERS & SCIENTISTS

Data pipelines are foundational infrastructure — when they're fast, correct, and maintainable, customers build on them with confidence. If you've spent the bulk of your career building large-scale data infrastructure — designing streaming or transformation primitives, reasoning hard about consistency and fault tolerance, and owning the systems that run under millions of customer workloads — this role might be for you. You'll be working on the pipeline layer at Snowflake: the constructs that define how customers move, shape, and maintain data. AI has a real presence in this work — in how customers use these pipelines and in how we think about building them — but the core job is hard data/pipeline infrastructure engineering, and that's what we're hiring for.


ABOUT THE TEAM

We build the core data engineering primitives that power Snowflake's streaming and transformation capabilities. From the constructs customers use to define real-time pipelines to the execution fabric that makes those pipelines reliable and cost-efficient at cloud scale, our team owns the full stack of declarative data engineering. We're a small, high-ownership team operating close to the product — which means your decisions ship, your architecture matters, and your fingerprints are on some of the most heavily used features in Snowflake's data engineering portfolio.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Define and drive the technical direction for Snowflake's core data engineering and streaming transformation primitives, spanning Streams, Tasks, Dynamic Tables, and adjacent pipeline constructs.

 - Identify and lead multi-quarter technical investments — performance, scalability, correctness, and reliability — translating ambiguous problem spaces into concrete engineering plans with measurable outcomes.

 - Partner with product, research, and peer engineering teams to co-design primitives that compose cleanly across the data engineering stack.

 - Operate as a force multiplier: run architectural reviews, set the technical bar for design documents, and help engineers grow through high-quality feedback and sponsorship.

 - Work directly with customers and field teams to understand real-world usage patterns; use that signal to prioritize what matters next.

 - Contribute to Snowflake's technical reputation — through internal design influence, external talks, or research publications in the data engineering space.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 15+ years of experience designing, building, and operating large-scale distributed data systems.

 - Deep expertise in at least one core area: stream processing, declarative query execution, pipeline orchestration, or data transformation at scale.

 - Strong computer science fundamentals — distributed systems, algorithms, fault tolerance, and consistency models.

 - Proficiency in C++ or Java; comfort with systems-level reasoning (latency, throughput, resource efficiency at cloud scale).

 - Demonstrated ability to lead cross-team technical initiatives from blank-page architecture through production at petabyte scale across thousands of concurrent workloads.

 - Strong written and verbal communication skills; ability to represent complex technical trade-offs clearly to engineering, product, and leadership audiences.


NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience with one or more major analytical databases (Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, Databricks, Teradata, etc).

 - Hands-on background in streaming, transformation, or event-driven systems (Flink, Kafka, Spark Structured Streaming).

 - Familiarity with the broader data engineering ecosystem: dbt, Airflow, Fivetran, Iceberg, Delta Lake.

 - Experience with CDC, change propagation, or incremental computation patterns.

 - Advanced degree (MS or PhD) in Computer Science, with emphasis on database or distributed systems.

jobs.title: Field Partner Leader, MEA
jobs.description:
Who we are

We're Redis. We built the product that runs the fast apps our world runs on. (If you checked the weather, used your credit card, or looked at your flight status online today, you’re welcome.) At Redis, you’ll work with the fastest, simplest technology in the business—whether you’re building it, telling its story, or selling it to our 10,000+ worldwide customers. We’re creating a faster world with simpler experiences. You in?

Why would you love this job?

We are looking for a tenacious and results-driven Field Partner Leader to build and run

Redis's channel and distribution business across India, the Middle East, and Africa. This is a

hands-on, individually-owned territory covering the full partner ecosystem including

distributors, resellers/VARs, system integrators, MSPs, and hyperscalers, across three

fast-growing, highly distinct regions. You'll set the distributor and partner strategy for the

territory, recruit and manage coverage, and turn partner relationships into measurable

pipeline and revenue. You'll report to the VP, Partner Sales, and be trusted to manage a

large, diverse territory.



What you’ll do:

 - Own the distributor and partner strategy for India, the Middle East, and Africa, tailoring approach by sub-region and partner type while keeping one coherent plan.

 - Recruit, onboard, and manage coverage across all partner types : distributors, resellers/VARs, system integrators (regional and global), MSPs, and hyperscaler/cloud alliance partners, closing white space across the territory.

 - Build and execute joint business plans (JBPs) with priority partners and distributors, aligning goals, investment, and GTM activity to Redis's growth priorities in each market.

 - Run a regular cadence of quarterly business reviews (QBRs) with distributors and top partners, tracking commitments, pipeline health, and performance against plan.

 - Design and deliver partner enablement ( product, sales, and technical readiness), so partners can position and sell Redis independently and confidently.

 - Plan and execute partner GTM events (regional roadshows, distributor summits, partner days) that generate pipeline and strengthen relationships across the territory.

 - Own pipeline and forecast governance for the partner business, delivering accurate, timely forecasts and a clear view of partner-sourced and partner-influenced revenue.

 - Define and track measurable partner performance (revenue, pipeline contribution, enablement completion, distributor scorecards) and hold partners accountable to targets.

 - Manage the territory primarily remotely, building strong, durable partner relationships across time zones and cultures without requiring constant in-person presence. Reserving travel for the highest-impact engagements..

 - Collaborate cross-functionally with sales, marketing, and product teams to keep partners current on Redis's roadmap and to align partner-led motions with direct sales coverage.



What will you need to have?

 - At least 7-10 years of quota-carrying channel, partner sales, or distribution management experience, with direct experience managing partners across India, the Middle East, and/or Africa.

 - Demonstrated experience managing the full spectrum of partner types :distributors, resellers/VARs, system integrators, MSPs, and hyperscalers.

 - A track record of building and running distributor strategy, including partner recruitment, coverage planning, and lifecycle/performance management.

 - Proven ability to run joint business planning and QBR cadences that drive measurable partner performance.

 - Strong remote relationship-management skills and able to build trust, drive accountability, and close deals with partners across multiple countries and cultures without heavy travel.

 - Experience owning pipeline and forecast governance, with the discipline to deliver accurate, timely forecasts.

 - Salesforce (or equivalent CRM) and campaign/partner-program management experience.

 - Comfort operating independently across a broad, multi-country territory spanning very different market maturities from established distribution markets to emerging ones.

 - Executive presence: able to represent Redis credibly with distributor and partner leadership across the territory.
   
   

Extra great if you have:

 - Existing relationships with distributors and partners across India, the GCC, and/or key African markets.

 - Experience selling or distributing infrastructure, database, or cloud/SaaS technology.

 - Familiarity with hyperscaler co-sell motions (AWS, Azure, GCP) alongside traditional distribution.

 - Experience launching or scaling a distributor network in an emerging or underpenetrated market.

 - Additional regional languages (e.g., Hindi, Arabic, French) beyond English.

 - A data-driven approach to prioritising effort across a large, diverse set of partners

and markets.

As a global company, we value a culture of curiosity, diversity of thought, and innovation from our employees, customers, and partners. Airwallex is the only unified payments and financial platform for global businesses. Built on Quartermaster, our internal agent platform, these agents autonomously plan, reason, and execute multi-step tasks against real infrastructure. You will be joining at the ground floor of this initiative, building the intelligent systems that fundamentally change how infrastructure work gets done at Airwallex.
