jobs.description:
About the Team

The Supply Chain Technology team within OpenAI’s Enterprise Platform & Technology builds and scales the systems and data architecture that power our core supply chain operations. We enable operational agility, visibility, and execution across planning through fulfillment and partner operations. Our focus is on modernizing workflows through strategic integrations, scalable automation, and seamless data flows empowering better decisions, reliable operations, and sustainable growth as OpenAI evolves.



About the Role

As a Senior Integrations Engineer, you will design, build, and operate the integrations and custom applications that connect OpenAI’s supply chain ecosystem. You will combine integration platforms, Python development, and APIs to deliver reliable data flows across enterprise systems, internal applications, and external partners.

You will partner closely with Hardware Operations, Application Engineers, Product Managers, IT, and business teams to improve data integrity, automate operational workflows, and support the transition from legacy systems to modern cloud platforms. This is a hands-on engineering role with ownership across architecture, implementation, deployment, and ongoing production support.




IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL

 - Define integration architecture and reusable design patterns across the supply chain technology landscape, balancing reliability, security, maintainability, and delivery speed.

 - Build and support integrations connecting ERP and SCM systems, internal applications, e-commerce platforms, third-party logistics providers (3PLs), contract manufacturers (CMs), retailers, and distributors.

 - Develop workflows, APIs, event-driven services, and batch and file interfaces, choosing the appropriate combination of platform capabilities and custom code.

 - Build production Python applications, integration services, reusable connectors, and operational tools with automated tests and maintainable interfaces.

 - Implement API and EDI partner integrations, including data mappings, partner onboarding, end-to-end testing, and transaction reconciliation.

 - Develop Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, tools, and plugins that connect AI-enabled applications to supply chain systems, with appropriate authorization, validation, audit trails, and transaction approvals.

 - Own production reliability through monitoring, alerting, incident response, and recovery. Diagnose and resolve data synchronization errors, API failures, and performance bottlenecks.

 - Embed access controls, segregation of duties, and auditability into integration design to support SOX compliance and internal control requirements.



You might thrive in this role if you

 - Bring 10+ years of experience in integration development, architecture, and design, with a track record of delivering and operating production systems.

 - Have hands-on proficiency with at least two integration platforms, such as Workato, MuleSoft, or Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC).

 - Use Python as a primary development language and have built production applications or integration services with automated testing and sound engineering best practices.

 - Have worked in high-volume environments such as customer-facing e-commerce and understand the supply chain processes behind order management, inventory, fulfillment, and returns.

 - Understand integration patterns, REST and SOAP services, asynchronous messaging, EDI, and data formats such as JSON, XML, and CSV.

 - Have directly built or maintained third-party API integrations and understand OAuth, webhooks, rate limits, pagination, retries, idempotency, and failure recovery.

 - Are comfortable working with AWS or Azure and supporting technologies such as Kafka, PostgreSQL, Redis, or Elasticsearch.

 - Have experience with microservices and containerized applications using Docker and Kubernetes.

 - Take ownership of systems throughout their production lifecycle, participate in on-call support, and prioritize reliability and operational readiness.

 - Communicate technical issues and business impact clearly to both engineering teams and nontechnical stakeholders.

 - Work independently, navigate ambiguity, and turn business needs into practical technical solutions.

Nice to Have

 - Experience building integrations to and from Oracle Fusion ERP or SCM, particularly across planning, procurement, manufacturing, inventory, logistics, and order management.

 - Experience developing MCP servers, plugins, or agentic automation for enterprise workflows.

 - Regular use of AI coding tools such as Codex, with a disciplined approach to reviewing, testing, and validating generated code.

jobs.description:
WHY HARVEY

At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched.

Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.




ROLE OVERVIEW

Harvey's first Sales Development Representatives in ANZ sit at the front end of how the region grows. Three hires join in the first round as founding members of the outbound function, generating qualified pipeline across Australia and New Zealand — from the region's largest law firms through to the in-house legal teams of major corporates, spanning Enterprise, Mid Market and SMB. Partnering directly with Account Executives, Legal Engineers and Marketing, the role researches target accounts, runs disciplined cold outbound, and converts senior legal stakeholders into first meetings. Legal buyers are among the most considered in software: decisions run across managing partners, general counsel, innovation leaders and IT, and earning a first conversation takes credibility rather than volume alone. There is no regional playbook yet — these hires help write it, alongside an ANZ Sales Development manager being hired in parallel.







WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own outbound pipeline generation for a named set of accounts across ANZ, spanning top-tier and mid-tier law firms and the in-house legal teams of major Australian and New Zealand organisations.

 - Research accounts properly before reaching out, developing a point of view on each firm's practice mix, strategic priorities, and where AI could change how its lawyers work.

 - Run disciplined multi-channel outbound across phone, email, LinkedIn and events to earn first meetings with managing partners, general counsel, innovation leaders and senior legal operations stakeholders.

 - Qualify inbound demo requests and marketing-generated leads, applying consistent criteria and routing high-intent accounts to the right Account Executive quickly.

 - Partner closely with Account Executives and Legal Engineers on account planning and pre-meeting context.

 - Maintain rigorous CRM hygiene and pipeline reporting, and iterate on messaging, sequences and target lists, feeding what works back into the regional playbook.







WHAT YOU HAVE

 - 2–3 years of sales experience overall, including at least one outbound sales development role (SDR, BDR or LDR) in B2B SaaS, with a demonstrable record of meeting or exceeding quota.

 - Evidence of genuine cold outbound: building your own target lists, writing your own sequences, making your own calls — rather than working inbound or warm leads alone.

 - Experience selling into highly considered buying processes, with comfort engaging senior stakeholders and multi-person buying committees.

 - Strong written and verbal communication, with the ability to be concise and credible in a first-touch email to a managing partner, and to convey technical concepts to non-technical audiences.

 - Proficient with Salesforce and a sales engagement platform such as Salesloft or Outreach, along with the reporting tools needed to explain your own pipeline.

 - Rigour and self-discipline: you work a territory systematically, keep your CRM clean, and can explain exactly why your pipeline looks the way it does.

 - Coachability and humility, and genuine interest in the legal industry. Familiarity with the ANZ legal or professional services market is a plus.

 - Valid Australian work rights. Harvey does not offer visa sponsorship for this role.




ADDITIONAL INFORMATION

 - Location: Sydney, NSW (Hybrid with flexibility)

 - Work eligibility: Must have valid Australian work rights; Harvey does not currently offer visa sponsorship for this role




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Structured hybrid working arrangement: 3 days in our Sydney office, 2 days working from home

 - Health Coverage: Fully covered private hospital insurance, plus extras for dental, optical, physio, mental health, and more.

 - Family & Fertility Support: Support for fertility treatments, adoption, and surrogacy through Carrot.

 - Retirement & Security: Comprehensive coverage designed to support your long-term well-being.

 - Paid Leave: Paid annual leave, sick leave, and fully paid parental leave for all parents.

 - Wellness & Perks: Daily in-office lunch, wellness memberships through Wellhub, and monthly commuting support.

 - Professional Development: Annual support for courses, certifications, conferences, and books.

 - Remote Work Allowance: Monthly support for home office, internet, and phone expenses.

 - Harvey Holiday: After four years, enjoy a four-week paid sabbatical to rest, travel, or explore new experiences.

jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff - Inference Runtime
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Modal’s Inference Runtime team owns the container runtime stack used to run inference and training workloads across our fleet. We work at the boundary of Linux, containers, filesystems, storage, GPU drivers, and distributed systems.Our goal is to make demanding ML workloads start quickly, run efficiently, and remain securely isolated — whether they use a single GPU, hundreds of gigabytes of memory, or multiple GPUs connected with RDMA.We’re looking for a systems engineer who enjoys working deep in the stack. You’ll build production runtime infrastructure in Rust and Go, diagnose difficult Linux and performance problems, and help determine the architecture of Modal’s container platform. You’ll also work closely with maintainers of gVisor and contribute to the runtime itself when the right fix belongs upstream.




WHAT YOU’LL WORK ON

 - Make container startup, checkpoint, and restore dramatically faster for large inference and training workloads.

 - Build multi-GPU and accelerator-aware snapshotting, including efficient handling of GPU memory and RDMA-enabled workloads.

 - Design zero-copy and low-copy data paths between container memory, filesystems, storage, and Modal’s runtime.

 - Optimize large snapshot pipelines using techniques such as parallel uploads, direct I/O, incremental snapshots, and more efficient memory handling.

 - Improve container image and filesystem performance across EROFS, FUSE, page caches, overlay filesystems, and remote storage.

 - Extend our sandboxed runtime to support new GPUs, drivers, profiling tools, and device capabilities across NVIDIA and AMD hardware.

 - Debug complex failures involving system calls, virtual memory, process lifecycle, kernel behavior, GPU drivers, and container isolation.

 - Safely roll out runtime and kernel changes across a heterogeneous fleet using compatibility controls, scheduling constraints, feature flags, and observability.

 - Work across the runtime, scheduler, storage, and GPU infrastructure—and take ambiguous production problems from investigation through deployment.


WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

 - Strong Linux systems knowledge, particularly processes, virtual memory, filesystems, system calls, scheduling, namespaces, cgroups, and signals.

 - Experience building or debugging container runtimes, sandboxes, Linux kernel, or similarly low-level infrastructure.

 - Strong programming ability in Rust, Go, or another systems language, with an interest in becoming productive in both Rust and Go.

 - Experience profiling and improving systems where memory movement, I/O, synchronization, or kernel interactions dominate performance.

 - Comfort debugging across abstraction boundaries, from application behavior down through runtimes, drivers, and the kernel.

 - An ability to turn loosely defined production problems into well-designed, reliable systems.

 - A desire to own important infrastructure and work closely with both internal teams and customers.


PARTICULARLY RELEVANT EXPERIENCE

Any of the following would be helpful, but none is required:

 - gVisor, runsc, runc, OCI runtimes, seccomp, or checkpoint/restore systems.

 - Linux kernel development, virtualization, sandboxing, kernel modules, or device proxying.

 - CUDA, ROCm, GPU drivers, accelerator virtualization, or GPU profiling.

 - RDMA and high-performance networking.

 - FUSE, EROFS, direct I/O, mmap, page-cache behavior, or storage engines.

 - Large-memory or multi-GPU inference and training systems.

 - Contributions to open-source systems software.

Prior gVisor or machine-learning experience is not required. We care more about strong systems fundamentals, curiosity, and the ability to learn unfamiliar parts of the stack.




WHY THIS ROLE

The container runtime is directly on the critical path for inference performance. Improvements here can substantially reduce cold starts, increase token throughput, unlock new accelerator types, and make previously impractical workloads possible.This is an opportunity to work on unusually deep systems problems with immediate production impact. You’ll have room to shape the architecture, contribute to open-source runtime technology, and take ownership of foundational infrastructure used by every inference and training workload on Modal.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer - Enterprise Platform
jobs.description: TL;DR We're looking for a Staff Software Engineer to help define the future of Lovable Enterprise. Some of the world's largest companies are already building with Lovable. Now we're building the platform that allows them to deploy Lovable securely, reliably, and on their own terms. How do you let an enterprise customer deploy Lovable inside their own cloud without slowing product development? How do you build a platform that works seamlessly across AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud without compromising security or developer experience? Those are the kinds of problems you'll solve. You'll define the technical direction for the platform that powers Lovable Enterprise—from cloud architecture and sandboxing to networking, encryption, and identity. Why Lovable? Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started. We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world. Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software. Why join now? Very few engineering roles offer this level of ownership. You'll help define a platform rather than inherit one. Many of the hardest architectural decisions haven't been made yet, giving you the opportunity to shape the foundation of Lovable Enterprise alongside engineering leadership. Whether you've been a Staff Engineer, Principal Engineer, founding engineer, or CTO, we're looking for someone who's already operated with this level of ownership—and wants to do it again on an even bigger stage. What you'll do You'll define the technical direction for the platform that lets enterprise customers run Lovable securely and at scale. You'll spend your time writing software, making architecture decisions, mentoring engineers, and working directly with customers on problems that don't have established playbooks. Examples include: Defining the architecture for enterprise deployments across AWS, Azure and Google Cloud, including deployments into customer-controlled environments. Building cloud-agnostic systems that give customers flexibility in how and where they run Lovable. Designing secure sandboxing and runtime environments for running untrusted code at scale. Setting the technical bar for networking, encryption, identity and enterprise infrastructure. Building the internal platform that helps our engineering teams ship faster. Mentoring engineers and raising the engineering bar across the organisation. Working directly with enterprise customers and cloud providers on complex infrastructure challenges. What we're looking for We're looking for a Staff-level (or equivalent) Software Engineer with deep platform and infrastructure experience who have set technical direction before. This is a role for engineers who enjoy building software that powers infrastructure, if you’re from a traditional DevOps background this is less likely to be a good fit. This is the role for you if you have: Strong programming skills in Go or Rust, or a comparable systems language (C++, Java or similar) Experience building enterprise products and working with enterprise customers. Designed and scaled distributed systems in production that are used by multiple teams. Built on Kubernetes (or a similar orchestrator) as a platform, not just deployed to it. Hands-on experience designing and running production systems across more than one major cloud (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud), with deep expertise in at least one. A product mindset. You care about the people using the systems you build, not just the systems themselves. Experience operating at Staff, Principal, founding engineer, or CTO-level scope. And deep experience in some of these: Shipping software into customer-controlled environments (BYOC, VPC, self-hosted, air-gapped). Sandboxing and isolation (containers, microVMs, multi-tenant security). Enterprise identity, networking and encryption (SSO/SCIM, KMS/BYOK, private networking). Our tech stack Languages: Go, Rust, TypeScript Cloud: AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, Cloudflare Infrastructure: Kubernetes, Terraform, Temporal, OpenTelemetry, CI/CD Data: PostgreSQL, ClickHouse, Firestore, Spanner, BigQuery About your application Please submit your application in English—it's our company language. We encourage anyone excited by the role to apply, even if your current title isn't "Staff Software Engineer." What matters most is the scope you've owned and the impact you've had. jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Algolia is the retrieval intelligence layer that turns intent into trusted, decision-grade outcomes. Powering more than 1.7 trillion queries a year for over 18,000 customers with millisecond latency and 99.999% reliability, we are the recognized leader for Search and Product Discovery by top industry analyst firms. The Algolia platform turns a company s products, content, and business rules into data that humans, applications and AI agents can act upon. The result is trusted customer experiences with stronger conversions for measurable business impact.
 

If you re a problem solver, able to think outside the box and eager to nurture others and learn from them, then this is your challenge!


As a principal engineer working across the entire frontend stack, from design-system primitives to product-level architecture, you will shape how developers build with Algolia and how customers experience our products.

In the Frontend Experiences team, we re on a mission to make it effortless for developers to build great search and discovery experiences on the front end, with libraries, components and tooling that are fast, accessible, and a pleasure to use. Our work reaches customers and their end users directly, on the web and on mobile, so the quality bar is high and the feedback loop is short.


Right now, that includes a cross-team, multi-quarter effort to evolve the Algolia Dashboard from a collection of product surfaces into one coherent environment: a new navigation and information architecture, a shared component foundation, and an interaction model that supports traditional configuration, conversational assistance and agentic workflows side by side.


The team is looking for an experienced individual who is well versed in defining, building and operating scalable architectures, with proven strengths in cross-team collaboration, taking solutions all the way through delivery to adoption by other engineering teams and by customers. You will play a pivotal role in architecting and implementing systems that play a central role across all of Algolia s front-end products, including libraries that run in production on thousands of customer sites. You will also play a role in training/mentoring and leading team members.


YOUR ROLE WILL CONSIST OF:


  • Defining the multi-year technical vision for Algolia s front-end platform, and turning it into roadmaps and projects that several teams can execute;
  • Playing an active role in the evolution of the Algolia Dashboard: shaping the experience architecture, the component strategy and the technical foundations for conversational and agentic UX, and partnering with engineering, product and design leadership to sequence delivery;
  • Driving convergence on a shared component library, reducing duplicated components and inconsistent patterns across product surfaces;
  • Designing and delivering solutions that will scale with significant volumes, be highly available, performant and resilient, including on pages and apps we do not control;
  • Owning solutions, taking them all the way through delivery to adoption by engineering teams and customers;
  • Shaping API design, versioning and backward-compatibility strategy for public libraries used by a large developer community;
  • Embodying technical expertise, that the team can refer to for advice or validation of a solution;
  • Setting engineering standards and best practices to be followed by engineers

YOU MIGHT BE A FIT IF YOU HAVE:


  • Excellent communication and organization skills
  • 10+ years of experience, with a track record of setting technical direction across multiple teams

jobs.title: Principal Solutions Engineer
jobs.description:
Position Overview

Solution Engineers (SEs) at SingleStore are solving some of the most cutting-edge technical challenges in today’s data-driven world.  When customers evaluate SingleStore, SEs are their trusted technical experts who evaluate, identify, and demonstrate how SingleStore can solve their mission-critical business needs.  As key contributors to our sales organization, Solution Engineers add tremendous value to the customer journey and directly impact company growth and revenue. 

In this role, you will be responsible for identifying the technical requirements necessary to deliver business value for our Fortune 1,000 customers.  Working in partnership with Enterprise Account Executives, you will help to acquire new customers and expand existing accounts.  You will do this by leveraging your technical skill set and business acumen to understand complex solutions and create high-quality demos that resonate with our customers. 

Role and Responsibilities

  • Partner with Prospects and Customers to understand their industries and strategies, and educate them on SingleStores strategy, technologies and vision.   
  • Partner with Account Executives to close new business (logos) and expand existing accounts
  • Partner with internal teams (Product, Engineering, Support, Marketing etc.) to share feedback on customer needs and requests 
  • Design, develop, and deploy Proofs of Concept (POCs) with prospective customers 
  • Drive the technical evaluation stage of the sales cycle, acting as the technical lead/subject matter expert (query tuning, load testing, etc.) 
  • Work to develop Channels and Partners for co-selling in the region.  

Required Skills and Experience

  • Fluency in English and regional languages 
  • Experience with Gen AI, ML and Advanced Analytics 
  • Experience successfully selling enterprise database technologies, distributed systems, and similar products 
  • Deep understanding of distributed database technologies, including both analytic and transactional processing 
  • Expertise executing POCs, with experience designing and deploying complex technologies into existing customer environments 
  • In-Depth understanding of data platforms, including various competitive products (Oracle, SQL Server, Postgres, MongoDB, Snowflake, Databricks, etc.)
  • Experienced in cloud and containerized environments, deployment and orchestration (including Linux and Kubernetes environments)  
  • Proficient programming skills in Python, Java, or other programming languages 
  • Ability to travel within the region and internationally
  • Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or a relevant technical field 

SingleStore is a global database company that empowers the world’s leading organizations to build and scale cutting-edge AI applications on a unified data platform that supports real-time transactions, analytics, and search. Our platform handles streaming data ingestion, vector search, full-text search, and multi-model data types - all with high performance, petabyte-scale capacity, high user concurrency, and low latency.

As a leader recognized by both Gartner and Forrester Wave, SingleStore serves the world ‘s leading data innovators including the top Fortune 500 enterprises. Our 95%+ gross retention rate reflects the strong satisfaction and trusts our customers place in the platform. SingleStore is owned by private equity firm Vector Capital and is headquartered in San Francisco, with offices worldwide, including Hyderabad.

To all recruitment agencies: SingleStore does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to SingleStore employees. SingleStore is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes and will not pay fees to any third-party agency or company that does not have a signed agreement with the Company.

jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer (Java) - Security - Elasticsearch
jobs.description:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

What is The Role

We are seeking a Principal Software Developer to join the Elasticsearch Security team. In this role, you will lead the architecture and design of Elasticsearch s main features. These features include authentication, authorization, and tenant isolation.

You will work with engineering and product leaders at Elastic. Your goal is to provide high-performance security at all levels. This includes ensuring that our distributed data store has top-quality security at scale.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Owning core security initiatives from architecture to production, focusing on the delivery of new critical features. Leading the technical design, plan, and execution for major security components inside the Elasticsearch core engine.
  • Developing the foundational security models for intricate features.
  • Optimizing security performance at scale in distributed systems environments.
  • Applying cryptographic solutions to address genuine customer use cases.
  • Ensuring robust data isolation within shared infrastructure supporting disparate customers.
  • Monitoring and applying the latest advancements and best practices in security. This includes authentication, identity management, cryptography, and data access management.
  • Collaborating with peers across the company to embed security into new customer features from the outset.
  • Drive vulnerability management efforts by collaborating closely with the InfoSec team to proactively identify, assess, and remediate security risks.
  • Leverage AI-driven tools to automate vulnerability triage, prioritization, and preliminary investigation, streamlining security workflows and reducing manual intervention.
  • Mentoring and coaching other engineers, fostering a culture of technical excellence and security-first development.

What You Bring

  • You have deep knowledge of Java internals and JVM memory management. You understand how concurrency models work. You can write code that is high-performance, thread-safe, and lock-free. This experience includes working with large open-source and enterprise codebases.
  • You have proven experience in designing and building systems for authorization that can scale. This includes deep experience designing scalable RBAC/ABAC models and token validation pipelines. It includes permission compilation and distributed cache invalidation strategies.
  • You have a solid comprehension of distributed systems security, including node-to-node mutual trust, zero-trust transport, partition tolerance, and cluster state propagation.
  • You have a deep knowledge of edge identity protocols (OAuth 2.0, SAML).
  • You have a proven track record of using AI to accelerate development, debug complex systems, and optimize code, while still owning the final outcomes.
  • You possess the ability to collaborate across functions and teams and seamlessly transition between different projects, codebases, or teams based on business priorities
  • You can work autonomously, drive decisions, and lead a distributed team by leveraging asynchronous, direct, and transparent communication.

Bonus Points

  • Knowledge of cipher suites, TLS handshakes, and PKI/certificate lifecycle management.
  • Cryptographic methods considering memory usage and delays.
  • Familiarity with the implications of Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC) and readiness to support the migration of services to quantum-resistant cryptographic algorithms.
  • Hands-on experience mapping engine-level technical controls to FedRAMP (Moderate/High), FIPS 140, and SOC 2 requirements.
  • Experience working on the internals of a data store or search engine.

Additional Information - We Take Care of Our People

As a distributed company, diversity drives our identity. Whether you’re looking to launch a new career or grow an existing one, Elastic is the type of company where you can balance great work with great life. Your age is only a number. It doesn’t matter if you’re just out of college or your children are; we need you for what you can do.

We strive to have parity of benefits across regions and while regulations differ from place to place, we believe taking care of our people is the right thing to do.

  • Competitive pay based on the work you do here and not your previous salary
  • Health coverage for you and your family in many locations
  • Ability to craft your calendar with flexible locations and schedules for many roles
  • Generous number of vacation days each year
  • Increase your impact - We match up to $2000 (or local currency equivalent) for financial donations and service
  • Up to 40 hours each year to use toward volunteer projects you love
  • Embracing parenthood with minimum of 16 weeks of parental leave

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Atlas Clusters Security
jobs.description:
MongoDB is seeking a Senior Software Engineer to join the Atlas Clusters Organization. The organization is responsible for building MongoDB Atlas, our database as a service offering and fastest growing product. Atlas allows users to deploy fault-tolerant, secure, globally distributed MongoDB clusters in just minutes. This includes developing software to interface with the three major cloud providers (AWS, Azure, and GCP) in order to bring security, durability, availability, and performance to all deployments of MongoDB.

Atlas Clusters Security builds the security experience that Atlas customers depend on for mission-critical applications. Across the organization we own cluster networking, data encryption, database authentication, and related controls.

This role sits on the Encryption & Compliance team. We own Encryption at Rest with customer-managed keys (Bring Your Own Key) across AWS, Azure, and GCP, including private networking to customer key management systems. We also own the security and compliance work that lets Atlas serve highly regulated markets, including government offerings and internal credential management. You will design and operate these systems in production, lead fleet-wide rollouts, and partner with customers when encryption or key-management issues hit their clusters.

We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in San Francisco and would like a hybrid or in-office working model.

What you’ll do

  • Build and design new features for MongoDB Atlas
  • Contribute to and lead complex technical projects
  • Work closely with product and design teams, considering the user’s perspective while building technical solutions
  • Work with customers and support engineers to fix issues
  • Collaborate with team members to develop our codebase, best practices, and design principles
  • Learn from and mentor other team members
  • Join an on-call rotation to support Atlas’ production services

We’re looking for someone who

  • Has at least 5 years of professional software development experience
  • Is skilled at writing large-scale, distributed backend systems in a compiled language (Java, Go, etc.)
  • Has experience with at least one major cloud provider (AWS, Azure, GCP)
  • Has led the launch of a new feature and maintained it in production
  • Is eager to solve tough problems
  • Has excellent communication skills
  • Is curious, collaborative, and motivated
  • Nice to have: experience with cloud key management (KMS / Key Vault / Cloud KMS), IAM, private networking, or encryption in a production SaaS environment

Success Measures

  • In 3 months, you ll have shipped code into production and collaborated with the team to solve tough problems
  • In 6 months, you ll have contributed to a large project and joined our on-call rotation
  • In 12 months, you ll have designed new features, led development work, and become a go-to expert on Encryption at Rest, customer-managed keys, or a related part of the system

About MongoDB

MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.

With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including AI-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.

jobs.description:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We re all in on this mission. If you are too, let s talk.

Job Duties and Responsibilities:

 

  1. Own and deliver complex, cross-team quality initiatives end-to-end — from ambiguous problem definition through architecture, implementation, and production rollout with minimal oversight
  2. Lead technical design discussions and drive stakeholder alignment on test strategy, architecture, and quality standards across engineering, product, and design
  3. Generate original solutions to ambiguous or previously unsolved quality problems; use sound engineering judgment when there is no obvious answer
  4. Anticipate, communicate, and manage quality and release risk across team boundaries; make prioritization trade-offs in partnership with engineering leadership
  5. Champion CI/CD, observability, monitoring/alerting, and production-hygiene practices, and drive their adoption beyond your own team
  6. Guide new and existing engineers on execution of sub-tasks within larger quality initiatives; raise the bar on code review standards for reliability, performance, security, and maintainability
  7. Partner with Engineering, Product, Design, Support, and Field/CSM teams to identify recurring customer issues and drive systemic product and process improvements
  8. Respond to and help resolve critical production issues/customer escalations during on-call rotation, driving root-cause analysis
  9. Mentor engineers, contribute to hiring and interviewing, and help improve engineering culture across the team and adjacent teams
  10. Drive adoption of AI powered testing capabilities — such as AI-assisted test case/script generation, self-healing test automation, and AI-driven test coverage or anomaly/log analysis — to improve quality engineering efficiency and coverage across teams
  11. Evaluate emerging AI tooling and agentic testing frameworks, and lead pilots to integrate them into existing automation and CI/CD pipelines



Minimum REQUIRED Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

 

  1.  8+ years of quality/test engineering experience with deep, hands-on test automation expertise across API, end-to-end, and performance/scale testing
  2.  8+ years of experience building and scaling automation frameworks using Java (or equivalent object-oriented language), including UI and/or API testing tooling
  3.  5+ years of experience designing and executing performance, load, and reliability testing (e.g., JMeter, Gatling) and using results to influence engineering decisions
  4.  5+ years of experience with observability and diagnostic tooling (Splunk, Datadog, Grafana), SQL, and Unix/Linux systems
  5.  Demonstrated ability to independently own and deliver cross-team, ambiguous technical projects without oversight, including planning, scoping, and production readiness (scalability, monitoring, alerting, resource efficiency)
  6.  Proven track record of influencing technical direction and driving alignment across multiple teams and stakeholders (engineering, product, design)
  7.  Strong written and verbal communication skills; experience leading technical design discussions and building stakeholder buy-in
  8.  Experience mentoring engineers and contributing to team hiring/interviewing processes
  9. Hands-on experience applying AI/ML tools to quality engineering — e.g., LLM-based test/code generation, AI coding assistants (Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code), self-healing test frameworks, or AI-driven anomaly/log analysis
  10.  Ability to quickly learn new technologies, evaluate trade-offs, and provide technical direction to others



 Education and Training:

 B.S. in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent practical experience. Advanced degree a plus.

Staff Software Engineer, Platform & Infrastructure

Tagline: Build the engine that builds Okta.

🚀 Your Mission: Define the Future of Developer Velocity at Okta

Are you a software engineer who believes that an exceptional developer platform is the key to unlocking engineering-wide innovation? Are you obsessed with building the high-leverage tools, services, and automated infrastructure that make building, testing, and deploying software a seamless experience?

Okta s Platform & Infrastructure team is the central nervous system for all of Okta Engineering. We build and own the entire internal developer platform—the CI/CD pipelines, the build-and-test orchestration, and the multi-cloud infrastructure that powers it all.

This isn t just about maintaining systems. It s about building a scalable, resilient, and blazing-fast "paved road" that empowers hundreds of engineers to ship high-quality code, multiple times a day.

Our scale is immense. We run tens of thousands of automated tests for every single commit. As Okta grows, this CI/CD workload presents a monumental engineering challenge.

Your primary goal will be to attack this problem head-on. You will be a key builder  in our quest to shrink massive, distributed compute jobs from hours or days down to just minutes. This role requires deep systems thinking, clever orchestration, and a passion for wringing every last drop of performance out of the infrastructure.

💻 What You ll Do (The Impact)

As a Staff Engineer, you are a technical leader, architect, and hands-on builder. You will:

  • Architect & Build: Design, code, and operate the next generation of our CI/CD platform, primarily using Go (Golang) and Python.
  • Master Kubernetes: Leverage your deep Kubernetes (K8s) expertise to orchestrate our complex and ephemeral build, test, and deployment workflows at massive scale.
  • Own the Multi-Cloud: Build services and automation that abstract and manage workloads extensively across AWS, GCP, and Azure, optimizing for cost, speed, and reliability.
  • Build a Platform, Not Just Tools: Create robust, self-service, and elegant internal products for our engineers. You ll treat our internal developers as your first-class customers.
  • Drive Innovation: You will not just use our build and CI systems, you will be responsible for building and scaling them.
  • Mentor & Lead: Collaborate with peers, mentor other engineers, and set the technical direction for major platform initiatives.

✅ What You ll Bring (The Requirements)

We are looking for a seasoned engineer who has built and scaled internal platforms before.

  • 5+ years of experience in Software Engineering 
  • Coding Skills: You are a strong software engineer first, with proven experience building and maintaining complex systems in Go (Golang) and/or Python.
  • Kubernetes is a Must: You have deep, practical experience building, running, and troubleshooting workloads on Kubernetes. You understand pods, operators, scheduling, and networking inside and out.
  • CI/CD as a Platform: You have architected, built, and/or significantly scaled CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab, Tekton, ArgoCD) as a platform for other engineers, not just as an end-user.
  • Cloud Expertise: You have demonstrable experience working in major cloud providers (AWS, GCP, Azure) and understand the nuances of their core services.
  • The Platform Ecosystem: You re fluent in the tools of the trade: Docker, container registries (like Artifactory), and modern build systems (like Gradle or Bazel).
  • Platform Mindset: You are customer-obsessed (your customers are other engineers) and have a proven ability to lead complex, cross-functional projects to completion.
  • Education: B.S. in Computer Science, equivalent technical experience, or just a proven track record of shipping incredible systems.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Platform Access (L2)
jobs.description:
Who we are 

At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

Our dedication to remote-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.
.

Hiring and how we work

We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions! 

Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings. 
.

 

See yourself at Twilio

Join the team as Twilio’s next Software Engineer, Platform Access (L2).

 

About the job

This position is an engineering role within Twilio’s Cloud Native Foundations Team, suited to an engineer focused on identity, governance, and automated access control across multi-cloud environments.

Our team manages identity federation, least-privilege access, and automated provisioning for hundreds of accounts across Amazon Web Services (AWS), Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud Platform (GCP). As an L2 engineer, you will help design, build, and operate access controls and platform security tools at scale. You ll get hands-on with multi-cloud IAM, contribute to Terraform-based infrastructure automation, and write code to ensure secure, seamless developer access—using modern AI-assisted tooling to move faster and ramp up your skills.



Responsibilities

In this role, you’ll:

  • WEAR THE CUSTOMER S SHOES: Help design, build, and operate automations and access tools that streamline developer workflows while keeping multi-cloud environments secure. Work with security and technical leadership to turn well-scoped tasks into working code.
  • BE AN OWNER (CODE QUALITY): Participate in code reviews and follow established patterns, testing standards and policy-as-code frameworks across the platform.
  • BE AN OWNER (INFRASTRUCTURE & OBSERVABILITY): Support multi-cloud access infrastructure spanning AWS, Azure, and GCP accounts using Infrastructure as Code (Terraform). Help maintain least-privilege IAM policies, identity federation, role provisioning, and automated lifecycle workflows across hundreds of cloud accounts. Help maintain observability coverage, including metrics, alerts, and basic distributed tracing, across core data pipelines.
  • CHAMPION ENGINEERING HEALTH: Build awareness of secure architectural practices and IAM best practices. Flag access drift, technical debt, security vulnerabilities, and platform issues to your team as you encounter them.
  • GROW AND COLLABORATE: Actively seek feedback and mentorship from senior engineers, participate in sprint planning, and share what you learn with peers as you grow into a more senior role.

 

Qualifications 

  • Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn t followed a traditional path, don t let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!


    • Experience: 1–2+ years of professional software engineering or DevOps/Platform engineering experience, with practical exposure to multi-cloud environments, Identity & Access Management (IAM), or platform automation.
    • Modern Development Workflow: Practical experience with, or a strong desire to learn, AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot) to help write code, automate testing, and support debugging workflows.
    • Infrastructure as Code & Automation: Practical experience or familiarity with Terraform, Harness, or similar IaC tools to manage cloud resources and access permissions programmatically.
    • Multi-Cloud Infrastructure: Experience with cloud environments, including basic exposure to account management, IAM permissions, or core services in at least one major provider—AWS (e.g., IAM, Organizations, SSO/Identity Center), Microsoft Azure (e.g., Microsoft Entra ID/Azure AD, RBAC, Subscriptions), or Google Cloud Platform (GCP) (e.g., Cloud IAM, Workload Identity, Projects). General familiarity with multi-account/multi-project cloud architecture is a plus.
    • Language Proficiency: Working knowledge of at least one of Shell, Terraform, YAML, or Go (Golang), with a willingness to build proficiency across the rest.

jobs.description:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

Consumer Growth Experience Engineering (CGX) builds the platforms and end-to-end experiences that power Affirm’s consumer growth across push, email, app, and web. We own the core engagement surfaces and systems that help customers discover value, onboard seamlessly, and take confident next steps by using personalization, segmentation, and experimentation to deliver the right experience at the right moment.

Our work sits at the intersection of product, analytics, design, platform, and growth. We focus on building scalable, reliable tooling and consumer experiences that enable rapid go-to-market, improve conversion and activation, and grow long-term customer value. If you’re excited about shaping high-impact consumer journeys, solving ambiguous growth problems, and turning strategy into measurable outcomes at scale, CGX is the team for you.

What You ll Do

  • You will be responsible for owning and delivering quarterly goals for your team, leading engineers through ambiguity to solve open-ended problems, and ensuring that everyone is supported throughout delivery.
  • You will support peers and stakeholders in the product development lifecycle by collaborating with product management, design, and analytics, participating in ideation, articulating technical constraints, and partnering on decisions that properly consider risks and trade-offs.
  • You will proactively identify project, process, technology, or business issues, advocate for them, and lead in solving them.
  • You will support the operations and availability of your team’s artifacts by creating and monitoring metrics, escalating when needed, and supporting “keep the lights on” and on-call efforts.
  • You will foster a culture of quality and ownership by setting or improving code review and design standards for your team, and advocating for them beyond your team through writing and tech talks.
  • You will help develop talent on your team by providing feedback and guidance, and leading by example.




What We Look For

  • You have experience leading significant mobile initiatives (React Native or native), including defining architecture, coordinating cross-functional launches, and maintaining high reliability in production environments.
  • You have experience working across the React Native and native boundaries (Swift/Kotlin), debugging platform-specific issues and improving developer tooling, CI/CD, and release processes for mobile apps.
  • You have experience implementing experimentation, feature flagging, and analytics instrumentation in mobile applications, ensuring safe rollouts and measurable impact.
  • You have experience shipping web apps using declarative UI frameworks like React or Vue.
  • You are proficient in working with JavaScript/TypeScript.
  • You have a total of 4+ years of experience as a software engineer.
  • You are experienced in designing, developing, and launching backend systems at scale using technologies like Python, Kotlin, AWS, MySQL, and Kubernetes.
  • You have experience defining a technical plan for the delivery of a significant feature or system component with an elegant, simple, and extensible design, and you write high-quality code that is easily understood and used by others.
  • You are proficient at making significant changes in a large codebase and have developed a suite of tools and practices that enable you and your team to do so safely.
  • Your experience demonstrates that you take ownership of your growth, proactively seeking feedback from your team, your manager, and your stakeholders.

  • This position requires either equivalent practical experience or a Bachelor’s degree in a related field.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, AI Security
jobs.description:
Join us in building the future of finance.

Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.

About the team + role

We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards. 

The mission of our team is to build a scalable and secure AI platform that enables security teams across Robinhood to develop and operate AI-powered agents and security solutions with confidence.

As a Staff Software Engineer on the AI Security team, you’ll help lead and build the foundational platform, infrastructure, and security primitives that make it easier for teams to develop AI-powered security capabilities at scale. You’ll work on complex engineering problems at the intersection of AI, distributed systems, and security, with a particular focus on areas such as identity, authentication, authorization, encryption, and platform safety.

You’ll partner closely with security and engineering teams across Robinhood to create systems that make AI development easier while ensuring security is built into the platform from the start. This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who enjoys building platforms, solving complex technical problems, and helping shape how AI is securely adopted across security.

This role is based in our Menlo Park, CA and Bellevue, WA office(s), with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week.

At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams. 

 

What you’ll do

  • Design and build a scalable AI platform that enables security teams to develop, deploy, and operate AI-powered agents and security capabilities
  • Build foundational platform services, APIs, libraries, and SDKs that make it easier for teams to integrate AI into security workflows
  • Design secure systems with strong identity, authentication, authorization, encryption, and data protection controls
  • Build and operate reliable, large-scale distributed systems that support AI-powered security use cases
  • Develop platform capabilities and guardrails that enable teams to safely build and operate AI agents
  • Partner with security, infrastructure, and engineering teams to understand their needs and translate them into reusable platform capabilities
  • Identify opportunities to improve platform performance, developer experience, reliability, and security through automation
  • Help shape the technical direction and architecture of Robinhood’s AI Security platform as the team and platform continue to grow

 

What you bring

  • 8+ years of software development experience
  • 6+ years of experience building large-scale distributed systems, with experience designing systems around security concepts such as authentication, authorization, identity, or encryption
  • Experience building AI platforms, AI infrastructure, or production systems that support AI-powered applications or agents
  • Proficiency in Go or Python, with strong problem-solving and production debugging skills
  • Experience with cloud-native platforms and distributed systems technologies such as AWS, Kubernetes, gRPC, or Kafka
  • Strong understanding of security fundamentals and experience incorporating security into the design of production systems
  • Experience designing and building reusable platform capabilities, APIs, libraries, or developer tooling
  • Proven experience delivering large engineering projects with meaningful, long-term impact
  • Strong technical judgment and the ability to make thoughtful trade-offs across security, reliability, scalability, and developer experience
  • Ability to solve complex engineering problems and collaborate effectively across security and engineering teams

 

What we offer

  • Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career
  • Performance driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, equity ownership, and 401(k) matching
  • Top Tier benefits to fuel your work, including 100% paid health insurance for employees with 90% coverage for dependents
  • Access to the Robinhood Employee Fund that gives eligible US employees the opportunity to invest in a private employee fund that provides exposure to Robinhood Ventures funds.
  • Access to the best AI tools on the market and continuous AI skill-building for every employee, technical or not. 
  • Lifestyle wallet - a highly flexible benefits spending account for wellness, learning, and more
  • Employer-paid life & disability insurance, fertility benefits, and mental health benefits
  • Time off to recharge including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, parental leave, and more!

jobs.location: Denver, CO - Hybrid; New York, NY - Hybrid; San Francisco, CA - Hybrid
jobs.description:
About Gusto

At Gusto, we re on a mission to grow the small business economy. We handle the hard stuff — payroll, health insurance, 401(k)s, and HR — so owners can focus on their craft and their customers. With teams in Denver, San Francisco, and New York, we support more than 500,000 small businesses nationwide and are building a workplace that reflects the people we serve.

All full-time employees receive competitive base pay, benefits, and equity (RSUs) — because everyone who helps build Gusto should share in its success. Offer amounts are determined by role, level, and location. Learn more about our Total Rewards philosophy.

AI is a fundamental part of how work gets done at Gusto. We expect all team members to actively engage with AI tools relevant to their role and grow their fluency as the technology evolves. AI experience requirements vary by role and will be assessed during the interview process.

About the Role:

As a Staff Software Engineer on the Cloud Infrastructure team, you ll build automation and evolve the foundational systems that support Gusto s products. This is a code-driven infrastructure role, well suited to someone with a DevOps, SRE, or platform engineering background who enjoys solving problems that help other engineers work more effectively. You ll help set the architecture, Infrastructure-as-Code patterns, and operational standards that every Gusto engineer builds on, with real autonomy over how it gets done. Key opportunities include migrating production applications into a modern AWS multi-account architecture, strengthening disaster recovery and compliance, and improving the speed and reliability of our infrastructure tooling.

About the Team:

Gusto s Cloud Infrastructure team builds and operates the AWS foundations that the rest of our engineering organization depends on. We manage infrastructure as code with Terraform/OpenTofu and run Spacelift, the platform hundreds of engineers use daily to deploy infrastructure changes. This experienced team partners with networking, compute, platform, and application teams to make Gusto s cloud infrastructure more reliable, resilient, and easier to use.

Here’s what you’ll do day-to-day:

  • Build and maintain AWS infrastructure using Terraform/OpenTofu, with changes managed through code rather than manual configuration.
  • Improve the speed, reliability, and usability of Spacelift workflows used by engineering teams across Gusto.
  • Partner with application and infrastructure teams to migrate production services into a modern AWS multi-account architecture.
  • Strengthen disaster recovery and compliance readiness by implementing and testing infrastructure resilience.
  • Refactor infrastructure code into modular, reusable components that simplify maintenance and future development.
  • Support engineering teams with cloud infrastructure needs, troubleshooting, and vendor integrations.
  • Leverage AI-assisted tools to accelerate infrastructure development, improve troubleshooting, and identify automation opportunities while maintaining a high bar for security, correctness, and reliability.
  • Participate in an on-call rotation focused on internal engineering support, turning recurring issues into automation and lasting improvements.

Here’s what we re looking for:

  • 8+ years of hands-on experience in infrastructure, platform, or site reliability engineering.
  • Deep, production-level AWS expertise across compute, networking, identity, and security primitives.
  • Demonstrated mastery of Infrastructure as Code (Terraform/OpenTofu strongly preferred; Crossplane, CloudFormation, or similar) including module design, state management, and scalable patterns for large teams.
  • Experience with multi-account AWS governance — AWS Organizations, OU design, SCPs/RCPs, and federated identity via IAM Identity Center or equivalent SSO.
  • Hands-on experience with a managed IaC orchestration platform (Spacelift, Terraform Cloud, etc.).
  • Experience operating production infrastructure for a customer-facing SaaS platform, including observability (monitoring, logging, alerting) and participating in incident response.
  • Track record of driving multi-quarter infrastructure initiatives to completion with minimal direction.

Bonus:

  • Operating Terraform/OpenTofu at large scale — managing thousands of workspaces or state files, module registries and versioning strategy, drift detection and remediation, and policy-as-code enforcement.
  • Experience in compliance-regulated environments (SOC 2, PCI, NIST).
  • Solid cloud networking foundations: VPC design, IP address management, DNS, egress control, and centralized traffic inspection.

Please note that travel to Gusto s office for onboarding is required for this position. If you have any questions regarding this requirement, please share with your recruiter.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, PEO
jobs.description:
About Gusto

At Gusto, we re on a mission to grow the small business economy. We handle the hard stuff — payroll, health insurance, 401(k)s, and HR — so owners can focus on their craft and their customers. With teams in Denver, San Francisco, and New York, we support more than 500,000 small businesses nationwide and are building a workplace that reflects the people we serve.

All full-time employees receive competitive base pay, benefits, and equity (RSUs) — because everyone who helps build Gusto should share in its success. Offer amounts are determined by role, level, and location. Learn more about our Total Rewards philosophy.

AI is a fundamental part of how work gets done at Gusto. We expect all team members to actively engage with AI tools relevant to their role and grow their fluency as the technology evolves. AI experience requirements vary by role and will be assessed during the interview process.

About the Role

Gusto is building a PEO (Professional Employer Organization): a product where Gusto becomes a co-employer for small businesses, taking on payroll, benefits, workers compensation, and HR compliance so owners don t have to assemble it themselves. It s one of the biggest strategic bets in the company.  As a Staff Engineer on PEO Growth, you ll own the path from how a business discovers PEO all the way to getting the business fully set up.  The decisions you make here shape whether a small business can adopt one of the most consequential products we ve ever shipped, or give up halfway through.

About the Team

PEO Growth owns the customer experience of adopting the PEO — the end-to-end journey that takes a business from interested to fully up and running. Much of what that journey depends on is built by other teams across Gusto, so our job is to make it feel like one coherent product rather than a series of handoffs.  That makes the work as much cross-team design and negotiation as it is code, and it means you ll have real influence over how the experience gets shaped, not just how it s implemented.  The team is a pod of engineers, product manager, and designer with a bias towards building and shipping.

Here s what you ll do day-to-day

  • Own the PEO Onboarding experience end to end — how a business learns about the PEO, commits to it, and gets set up on it — and be accountable for whether customers make it all the way through.
  • Set technical direction: turn ambiguous product bets into designs, sequencing, and durable abstractions that hold up as the product and its audience grow.
  • Build in a regulated domain where quality and accuracy is critical.
  • Partner across other app teams to integrate their domains into one coherent journey, and negotiate the seams when ownership is unclear.
  • Use AI as a normal part of how you work — coding agents, review, debugging, and codebase exploration — and help build AI-assisted guidance into the onboarding experience itself so customers get unstuck without waiting on a human.
  • Instrument the funnel and make decisions from it: define what "onboarding is working" means, measure it, and use experiments rather than intuition to decide what to change.
  • Raise the engineering bar in a fast-moving area — reviews, testing strategy, observability, and the judgment calls about where to build carefully and where to move fast.

Here s what we re looking for

  • 8+ years of professional software engineering experience, including meaningful time owning customer-facing product surfaces in a large production codebase.
  • Strong full-stack range: comfortable in a mature server-side codebase and in a modern component-based frontend. Ruby on Rails and React/TypeScript are what we use and are desirable, but we care more about depth than the specific stack.
  • Demonstrated AI fluency: you already use AI tooling in your day-to-day engineering work, can speak concretely about where it helps and where it doesn t, and you keep up as the tooling changes.
  • High ownership in ambiguity. You can take a fuzzy business need, shape it into something buildable, and ship it without waiting for a perfect spec — and you anticipate what the team will need next instead of reacting to it.
  • A strong collaborator and influencer across team boundaries, with a track record of leveling up the engineers around you.
  • [Bonus] Experience in growth  — funnels, conversion, plan and product configuration, or the systems that turn a purchase decision into a provisioned customer.
  • Bachelor s degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Our cash compensation amount for this role is targeted at $163,000–$204,000 in Denver & most remote locations, and $197,000–$247,000 for San Francisco & New York. Stock equity is additional. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including candidate experience and expertise and may vary from the amounts listed above.

Gusto has physical office spaces in Denver, San Francisco, and New York City. jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Payments (AirCover Insurance Platform)
jobs.description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Community You Will Join

The AirCover Insurance Platform team builds the systems behind AirCover, which includes Host liability insurance, Experiences liability insurance and Host damage protection. We make it possible to launch and operate insurance products across global markets, and to learn quickly what increases the number of Hosts and guests who are protected. The team works with engineering, product, data science and legal partners across Airbnb s hubs.

What kind of Software Engineer are we looking for?

As a Staff Engineer on the AirCover Insurance Platform, you will lead the design and evolution of the core subsystems that manage policies, coverage, enrollment and regional rules, and the experimentation capabilities that drive attach rate. At the staff level, you establish the technical vision, then deliver a solution that is flexible, always available, auditable and able to scale with the needs of the business.

The Difference You Will Make

  • Design the future-state architecture that lets us expand AirCover to new regions and products without rebuilding for each market, balancing short-term launch needs against long-term technical quality.
  • Lead the design of an experimentation framework for insurance offers, pricing and placement, with trustworthy measurement of attach rate and downstream outcomes.
  • Lead engineers inside and outside your team in building these solutions, and be the technical lead and owner of significant scope through ambiguity.
  • Engage early with product managers, designers, data scientists and legal partners to shape requirements and steer teams toward the most efficient path to our goals.
  • Raise the bar for technical quality from design, through code review, to production operations.
  • Mentor engineers, and be a player/coach who helps build the team and drives collaboration across multiple teams.
  • Apply emerging technology, including LLMs, where it improves automation and the experience for Hosts and guests.

A Typical Day

  • Write and review designs and code for high-availability, distributed backend services.
  • Make architectural trade-offs and scale services in a regulated, multi-region environment with strong audit, privacy and data-integrity needs.
  • Analyze data to find gaps in conversion and coverage, and turn insights into product and platform changes.
  • Partner with Product, Data Science, Data Engineering, Legal and platform teams to drive engineering decisions and influence outcomes.
  • Present technical and product deep dives to stakeholders and leadership.

Your Expertise

  • 9+ years of relevant software development experience in a fast-paced tech environment (or 7+ with an advanced degree).
  • Expertise in backend systems in large-scale, service-oriented architectures, with real-world experience in at least one of Java, Kotlin, Python, Go or similar.
  • Experience designing multi-region or multi-tenant platforms with configurable, rules-driven behavior.
  • Experience with A/B testing and experimentation systems, and with using data to improve conversion or attach rates.
  • Proficiency designing and operating high-performance systems with reliable monitoring and logging, and working knowledge of relational databases and SQL.
  • Good judgment in balancing short-term business needs with long-term technical quality.
  • Experience in insurance, payments, fintech or other regulated domains is a plus.
  • Hands-on technical leadership across multiple teams, with excellent communication skills for technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Bachelor s degree or equivalent practical experience.

Our Commitment To Inclusion & Belonging

Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.

How We ll Take Care of You:

Our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs and market demands. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role may also be eligible for bonus, equity, benefits, and Employee Travel Credits.

jobs.title: Senior Staff Engineer, AI
jobs.description:
The AI organization at Asana builds the platform and products that bring AI into how the world s teams work. That includes AI Teammates that take on work alongside people, the orchestration layer that lets agents plan and act across the Work Graph, and the AI platform that every AI feature at Asana runs on. The platform covers model access, retrieval, context, evaluation, and production quality.

We are looking for a Senior Staff Software Engineer to set technical direction across this organization. You will lead the hardest cross-team problems in AI at Asana, make architectural calls that hold up as models and the industry shift underneath us, and help senior leadership shape where AI takes the product next. The scope spans multiple engineering teams across San Francisco, New York, Vancouver, and Warsaw.

This role is based in our San Francisco office with an office-centric hybrid schedule. The standard in-office days are Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday. Most Asanas have the option to work from home on Wednesdays. Working from home on Fridays depends on the type of work you do and the teams with which you partner. If you re interviewing for this role, your recruiter will share more about the in-office requirements.

What you’ll achieve

  • Define the technical vision and architecture for Asana s AI Org that includes AI platform, Agent systems and Studio in partnership with engineering and product leadership
  • Partner with Product, Design, Data Science, Security, and Legal to take ambitious AI products from prototype to reliable, trusted enterprise features
  • Lead strategic initiatives that span multiple teams, such as agent runtime and orchestration, context and memory for agents grounded in the Work Graph, and reliable, cost-efficient LLM inference at enterprise scale
  • Set the bar for how Asana measures AI quality, including offline and online evaluation, production monitoring, and the feedback loops that turn real usage into better agents
  • Make and guide high-stakes technical decisions on model and vendor strategy, build versus buy, and shared platform abstractions, and make sure those decisions age well
  • Influence R&D-wide AI strategy by bringing a grounded view of the model and agent landscape to senior leadership
  • Mentor staff and senior engineers, grow tech leads across the AI organization, and raise the bar for design and architecture reviews
  • Represent Asana s AI engineering work externally through talks, writing, and the technical community, and help attract senior talent

About you

  • 10+ years of experience building production software, including significant time as a technical lead whose work spanned multiple teams
  • 3+ years building production systems with LLMs or machine learning, such as agents, retrieval, evaluation, or inference infrastructure
  • Track record of leading architecture and initiatives across organizational boundaries, with decisions that proved right over time
  • Hands-on fluency with the current AI landscape, including foundation models, agent frameworks, tool use, and evaluation methods, with opinions strong enough to set direction and flexible enough to change with new evidence
  • Deep experience with distributed systems and the reliability, latency, and cost challenges of running them at scale
  • Able to communicate clearly at every level, from design reviews with engineers to strategy discussions with executives, and to bridge product, business, and technical language
  • Passionate about coaching and mentoring engineers, including senior and staff-level engineers
  • Experience with multi-tenant enterprise SaaS, and with security, privacy, and data governance for AI systems, is a plus
  • Deep care for collaboration and an ability to foster an inclusive culture where everyone can bring their full selves to work and thrive
  • Demonstrates curiosity about AI tools and emerging technologies, with a willingness to learn and leverage them to enhance productivity, collaboration, or decision-making

At Asana, we re committed to building teams that include a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills, as this is critical to helping us achieve our mission. If you re interested in this role and don t meet every listed requirement, we still encourage you to apply.

What we ll offer

Our comprehensive compensation package plays a big part in how we recognize you for the impact you have on our path to achieving our mission. We believe that compensation should be reflective of the value you create relative to the market value of your role. To ensure pay is fair and not impacted by biases, we re committed to looking at market value which is why we check ourselves and conduct a yearly pay equity audit.

For this role, the estimated base salary range is between $297,000 - $350,000. The actual base salary will vary based on various factors, including market and individual qualifications objectively assessed during the interview process. The listed range above is a guideline, and the base salary range for this role may be modified.

In addition to base salary, your compensation package may include additional components such as equity, sales incentive pay (for most sales roles), and benefits. If you re interviewing for this role, speak with your recruiter to learn more about the total compensation and benefits for this role.
